# Senior Bookkeeper - Remote, US Clients, Growth

VirtuHire

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6198772206214889285?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2256545273347666130&crId=US_0US_0)

Company Overview A well-established US-based bookkeeping and tax practice servicing a diverse client base across multiple industries, primarily within California. The business provides professional accounting, bookkeeping and tax support services to small and medium-sized businesses and is currently expanding following the acquisition of an additional client portfolio. The environment is fast-paced, service-driven and highly detail-oriented, requiring strong technical bookkeeping capability and the ability to manage multiple client accounts independently.
Role Summary An experienced Senior Bookkeeper is required to manage full-cycle bookkeeping functions across a portfolio of US-based clients. The successful candidate will work primarily within QuickBooks Online and will be responsible for reconciliations, financial reporting support, payroll-related bookkeeping functions and maintaining accurate financial records to US standards. This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical accounting knowledge, excellent organisational skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Key Responsibilities Manage full-cycle bookkeeping across multiple client accounts
Maintain accurate financial records and bookkeeping systems
Perform bank, credit card and loan reconciliations
Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations and profit & loss reporting
Reconcile undeposited funds and gross up sales reports from net deposits
Work with multiple POS systems and financial data sources
Support payroll journal reconciliation and payroll-related bookkeeping functions
Liaise with clients professionally regarding bookkeeping matters
Maintain bookkeeping accuracy in line with US accounting standards
Assist with month-end and year-end bookkeeping processes
Utilise AI and automation tools effectively to improve efficiency while maintaining accuracy
Requirements QuickBooks Online Certified
Minimum 5 years of full-time bookkeeping experience
Strong US bookkeeping and US data-capture experience
Experience servicing multiple industries
Advanced QuickBooks Online proficiency with recent hands-on usage
Strong understanding of balance sheet reconciliations
Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, assets, liabilities and loan reconciliations
Experience with payroll journals and payroll reconciliation processes
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Strong understanding of financial reporting and bookkeeping best practices
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
Strong communication and organisational skills
Reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home-office setup
Minimum dual-screen setup with dedicated workspace
Willingness to work US Pacific working hours on a permanent basis
Highly Advantageous California sales tax exposure
Experience across construction, real estate, restaurants, retail, wholesale or entertainment industries
Exposure to US corporate tax environments
Experience working with multiple POS systems
Strong AI literacy and workflow optimisation skills
Technical Skills QuickBooks Online
Microsoft Excel
US Payroll Workflows
Financial Reconciliation
POS System Integration
Bookkeeping Reporting
Financial Data Management
Ideal Candidate Profile Senior-level bookkeeper with strong technical capability
Highly detail-oriented and accurate
Able to manage workload independently with minimal supervision
Comfortable working within a fast-paced US client environment
Professional, reliable and service-oriented
Strong problem-solving and organisational skills
Comfortable communicating directly with clients and stakeholders
Application Requirements Updated CV detailing bookkeeping experience and industries supported
Confirmation of QuickBooks Online certification
Summary of US bookkeeping and US accounting exposure
Confirmation of home-office setup and internet reliability
Introductory video outlining communication style and bookkeeping background
Confirmation of availability to work US Pacific hours
Remote working environment
Competitive salary package
Long-term opportunity with a growing US-based accounting practice
Exposure to a diverse US client portfolio

# Executive Assistant III

Full-time

University of California, San Francisco

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/280201864897292666?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=330&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4155059198566415025&crId=US_0US_0)

**Description**

**Job Summary**

A key member of the Quantitative Biosciences Insitutes leadership support team oversees the Directors and leadership teams daily administrative needs and schedule and functions with a high degree of autonomy and utmost discretion. The incumbent will act in a problem-solving and coordinating role in support of the Director and his leadership team working with a wide variety of personnel internally and externally including University leaders faculty staff and students.

Key areas of responsibility include: managing a complex executive calendars and meeting coordination; providing on-site logistical support for meetings (slides agendas refreshments video teleconferencing etc.); coordinating complex travel logistics (includes arranging flights transportation lodgings meeting registrations and keeping track of financial commitments and processing/tracking reimbursements); using skilled judgment and discretion in triaging emails and other incoming requests for the Director and QBI leadership team; drafting written comunications and materials; provide background materials talking points and briefing materials for the Director and composing and maintaining the Directors task lists. The incumbent will take on a variety of ad-hoc projects as needed.

Responsibility for providing high executive level of support and for directing inquiries to appropriate resources or contact as needed requires an understanding of Directors goals and priorities and a thorough understanding of the QBIs structure academic programs policies workflow and communication demands. This position uses concepts and organziational objectives to resolve the most complex issues with institution-wide impact and must have an expert level of professionalism confidentialtiy and diplomacy.

**Responsibilities**

**Executive Administrative Operations and Scheduling**

Oversees and ensures the daily administrative operations run smoothly for the executives office.

- Independently coordinates and manages a broad range of confidential complex and high-level issues related to the Directors schedule and his leadership team.
- Heavy scheduling of a variety of short and long-term meetings which involve details that require independent analysis and decision making.
- Manages the travel plans and expenses and invited guests; process travel plans including securing airfare and hotel accommodations and prepare and process appropriate paperwork associated with travel; reconcile travel and expense transactions and reimbursements in accordance with university policies.
- Serves as the point of contact for most Directors and his leadership meetings.

**Executive Gatekeeping and Leadership Coordination**

Functions as the gatekeeper understanding the requirements of the executive in order to prioritize issues according to urgency and to allocate time for scheduled events travel and meetings.

- In coordination with leadership team monitors QBIs activities and commitments and independently analyzes issues that may affect the ORU.
- Reschedule meetings at a moments notice to accommodate for time-sensitive meetings.
- Functions as a liaison and supports the coordination and maintenance of communication and information for the QBI leadership team.

**Executive Briefings and Meeting Preparation**

Researches compiles and summarizes issues policies and topics; provides background information talking points and briefing materials for the executive and QBI leadership team.

- Briefs executive and QBI leadership in a timely fashion with regard to priorities and deadlines on the status of pending issues.
- Ensures that the Director and his leadership team are prepared for every meeting and event with appropriate briefing materials speaking points location and other important details.
- Coordinates information from other units and tracks to ensure completion with sufficient time for executive review in advance of meetings.
- Researches analyzes and synthesizes information to prepare executive briefings reports and summaries.

Senior Executive Assistant 5-10 yrs CTC Relations is a premier boutique recruiting firm. We are currently working with an International premier legal firm representing companies at every stage of development, from entrepreneurial start-ups to multibillion-dollar global corporations, venture firms, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 investment banks that finance and advise them. Job Description Provides administrative support: Extensively manages calendar. Plans, negotiates and schedules meetings to accommodate executive and others. Uses discretion and judgment to determine the priority of meetings. Reschedules existing meetings if needed to accommodate meetings with more urgency. Keeps executive informed of upcoming appointments and deadlines. Coordinates meetings with internal employees and external contacts. Schedules meeting rooms, orders food, visitor passes, and equipment as required. Greet and escorts visitors, meeting attendees, and candidates. Manages complex travel arrangements. Reserves transport and accommodations taking into consideration executive preferences, cost, and timing implications. Ensures that executives have necessary paperwork for travel (e.g., tickets, confirmation numbers, visas, itineraries) and keeps an eye on delays and schedule changes to re-arrange as necessary. Completes business expense claims promptly and follows up on reimbursements if necessary. Responsible for all aspects of event planning for the overall investment strategy team, as well as assisting with the planning for Crescent's annual off-site conference. Manages incoming and outgoing correspondence (post, e-mail, etc.); handles routine issues directly and prioritizes remainder. Creates and maintains lists, files and databases to enhance efficiency and productivity. Organizes and maintains information that may be sensitive, confidential, or technical in nature. Audits records for discrepancies and reconciles issues as appropriate. Covers telephones and takes accurate written messages and notes. Arranges for back-up coverage when necessary and provides back-up coverage when other executive assistants are out of the office. Demonstrates an understanding of other executives' needs, preferences, and schedules in order to provide support when primary assistant is out of the office. Identifies opportunities to improve work processes/flow in order to leverage own and department's workload. Keeps abreast of internal administrative policies, practices, and guidelines (e.g., travel and expense guidelines, office processes). May assist with arranging and preparing food and beverage set-up for executives and visitors. May provide administrative support to projects or broader initiatives. Acts as the first point of contact for inquiries: Assesses level of urgency and determines business nature of inquiries. Uses judgment to determine what inquiries need to be put through to executive. Determines when and how to interrupt executives for urgent or time sensitive requests. Responds to internal and external queries concerning guidelines, procedures or operations. Uses knowledge of the function and executive's role to independently resolve issues for executives, escalating and redirecting more technical inquiries as appropriate. Proactively develops relationships with key internal and external contacts in order to source information or redirect calls appropriately. Assist with personal work for the executive as necessary: Assists with personal appointments, reservations, errands, household needs, special events and miscellaneous tasks. This may require interacting with family members and outside parties (e.g., house managers, hotel and restaurant staff, etc.). Coordinates personal dinners, special events and social functions. Maintains personal financial data and information. Qualifications Minimum 5-10 years of prior Executive Assistant job experience Ability to proactively anticipate needs of executive and get tasks done without direction, using formal channels and informal network as appropriate. Takes the initiative by identifying issues and recommending solutions. Uses effective written and verbal communication skills with a diverse group of employees, senior leaders, and individuals outside the organization. Professional service orientation and builds rapport with peers and internal and external contacts. Strong team player within the broader administrative function. Exhibits sound judgment in resolving matters of high complexity. Maintains the utmost level of discretion and confidentiality. Actively demonstrates commitment by maintaining a consistent, punctual and predictable work schedule. Effectively prioritizes assigned work and completes it in a timely manner. Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office and other relevant software and applies it to work assignments. Working Conditions The responsibilities of this position may require employees to respond and/or work outside normal business hours. May be on-call at times, particularly during executive's travel schedule. Additional Information Compensation: $100,000 plus DOE CTC Relations

# Senior Bookkeeper & Executive Assistant

$41 - $50 per hour

Omninet Capital

[Beverly Hills, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Beverly-Hills%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6862367288779166911?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6427&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6189105136860138738&crId=US_0US_0)

JobSummary
Omninet Capital is a Beverly Hills-based owner-operator of multifamily and commercial real estate with a national portfolio. We are seeking an experienced, highly trustworthy Senior Bookkeeper & Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to one of the company’s Principals. This position is approximately 80% bookkeeping and accounting support and 20% executive support.

The ideal candidate brings a strong accounting background, exceptional attention to detail, and the judgment required to handle highly confidential financial, business, and personal information. We are looking for someone who takes pride in producing accurate work, stays organized across competing priorities, and brings a consistently positive, solutions-oriented approach to everything they do.

This is an on-site role based in our Beverly Hills office.

KeyResponsibilities
Bookkeeping&Accounting-Approximately80%

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping for personal, investment, and related business accounts.

Record and categorize financial transactions accurately and consistently.

Manage accounts payable, including reviewing invoices, coordinating approvals, and processing payments.

Reconcile bank, credit card, investment, and other financial accounts on a monthly cycle.

Maintain accurate general ledgers and supporting documentation.

Track expenses, reimbursements, deposits, and cash activity, including proper allocation of costs across entities and accounts.

Prepare monthly financial reports, account summaries, and supporting schedules.

Assist with budgeting, cash-flow tracking, and variance reporting.

Coordinate with internal accounting teams, external accountants, tax professionals, financial advisors, and other service providers.

Organize and maintain records needed for tax preparation, investments, audits, and financial reporting.

Identify discrepancies, research issues, and ensure outstanding items are resolved promptly and escalated when appropriate.

Maintain highly organized and secure electronic and physical financial records consistent with company data-security and retention standards.

Executive&AdministrativeSupport-Approximately20%

Provide responsive administrative and executive support to the Principal.

Manage scheduling, appointments, correspondence, and travel coordination.

Assist with document preparation, filing, recordkeeping, and special projects.

Coordinate with vendors, advisors, business partners, and other professional contacts.

Track follow-up items and ensure commitments and deadlines are met.

Handle administrative and occasional personal requests on behalf of the Principal with professionalism, discretion, and flexibility.

RequiredQualifications

5+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, or financial administration experience.

Strong working knowledge of general accounting principles, reconciliations, accounts payable, and financial recordkeeping.

Proficiency with QuickBooks and Microsoft Excel.

Demonstrated ability to manage highly sensitive financial, business, and personal information with the utmost confidentiality.

Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy.

Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage changing priorities.

Professional and polished, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Dependable, service-oriented, and willing to assist beyond core bookkeeping responsibilities when needed.

PreferredQualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

Experience supporting a Principal, executive, family office, investment office, or high-net-worth individual.

Experience in real estate, investment management, or a multi-entity environment.

WorkEnvironment&Schedule

On-site position based in Beverly Hills, California; standard business hours, Monday through Friday.

Occasional local travel or off-site errands may be required; a valid California driver’s license and reliable transportation are required.

Location
Beverly Hills, CA (Onsite)

Job Type
Regular, Full-Time

Compensation Range
$41.00 - $50.00 per hour ($85,280 - $104,000 annualized), plus discretionary bonus eligibility and full benefits.

Omninet Capital, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

# Senior Bookkeeper (New York City Metropolitan Area)

Location:USCompany:Reem Acra

## Description:

**SENIOR BOOKKEEPER**

Location: New York City, Manhattan

Position: Full-Time \| In-Person

Salary: $80,000–$95,000 annually, commensurate with experience

Experience: Minimum 5 years; 10+ years preferred

_About the Position_

Reem Acra, an internationally recognized luxury fashion house specializing in bridal couture and eveningwear, is seeking a highly experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to oversee the company’s daily financial operations. The ideal candidate will have extensive bookkeeping experience within the fashion and apparel industry, preferably bridal, couture, luxury fashion, or made-to-order manufacturing.

_Key Responsibilities_

● Manage daily bookkeeping, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

● Track client deposits, installment payments, outstanding balances, and final payments for made-to-order garments.

● Monitor production expenses, fabric purchases, embroidery, trims, and garment costing.

● Maintain accurate financial records for wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer transactions.

● Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and vendor statements.

● Monitor outstanding receivables and coordinate collections.

● Oversee payroll-related bookkeeping and expense reporting.

● Prepare monthly financial reports, cash-flow summaries, and reconciliations.

● Track inventory-related costs and coordinate with production teams.

● Work closely with outside accountants on tax preparation and year-end reporting.

_Qualifications_

● Minimum 5 years of professional bookkeeping experience; 10+ years preferred.

● Experience in fashion, apparel manufacturing, bridal, or luxury retail strongly preferred.

● Strong understanding of made-to-order production, client deposits, inventory, and costing.

● Advanced knowledge of QuickBooks andMicrosoft Excel. Experience with Shopify, A2000, or Apparel Magic a plus.

● Experience with invoice processing.

● Comprehensive knowledge in managing accounts receivable, chargebacks, aging reports, and collections processes.

● Experience with domestic and international vendors.

● Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and financial accuracy.

● Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality, and manage multiple priorities.

● Bachelor's degree, CPA Certified a plus

Benefits: Health Insurance and Dental

_Ideal Candidate_

We are seeking a dependable, hands-on financial professional who understands the operational needs of a luxury fashion house and can take full responsibility for maintaining accurate and timely financial records. The ideal candidate is an accountant with a keen eye for detail, a strong propensity for precision, and the ability to communicate financial information clearly and effectively. The candidate should have a comprehensive background in accounting, financial reporting, and consolidations acquired through at least three years of experience.

_To Apply_

Please submit your résumé, relevant fashion or apparel industry experience, salary expectations, and availability to info@reemacra.com.

# Sr. Marketing Manager (New York)

Location:Grand Central, NYCompany:BeSound

## Description:

**Company Description**

BeSound is focused on modernizing breast care with advanced technology designed to detect what traditional mammograms can miss. The organization is committed to improving early detection and diagnostic accuracy, helping clinicians and patients make more informed decisions. BeSound works at the intersection of medical innovation and patient-centered care, striving to close gaps in current screening methods. Team members join a mission-driven environment where their work directly contributes to better health outcomes and greater peace of mind for those at risk. To learn more about BeSound, visit: www.besoundbreast.com

**The Role:**

BeSound is seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Marketing Manager to drive the growth and engagement of our community through innovative marketing programs. Reporting to the Head of Marketing and collaborating closely with our Clinical and Product teams, you will work cross-functionally and with external partners to implement high-impact organic and paid campaigns that increase awareness, acquisition, and retention. This role is a blend of strategic planning and hands-on execution, perfect for a creative and analytical marketer passionate about making a meaningful impact in the health and wellness space.

**Who you are:**

You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about taking a defining role at an early-stage startup. You’re both creative and analytical and enjoy solving complex problems. You’re comfortable with change, and ready to pivot in response to customer and client feedback and needs.

You have a strong base of knowledge in acquisition and growth marketing from 4-6 years at a DTC consumer brand. You’ve scheduled and sent / posted hundreds of brand emails and social posts and know your way around Google Analytics. You’re looking to work in a high-growth, venture capital backed business with great mentors and teachers.

**Required skills / experiences:**

- Hands-on experience managing organic growth in-house for a full funnel DTC business including email campaigns, organic social, partnerships, and influencer. Prior experience with local marketing is a plus.
- Proficiency in analyzing campaign data, identifying trends, and leveraging insights to refine marketing strategies and optimize ROI.
- Proven experience managing CRM platforms like Iterable (or similar) to drive acquisition and retention through advanced client segmentation, in-depth retention flows, and data-driven lifecycle campaigns. Skilled at creating personalized, automated workflows that enhance customer engagement and maximize LTV.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to drive both creative and technical aspects
- Familiarity with digital marketing KPIs such as CPA, CPC, CPM, LTV and ROAS
- Ability to work independently, meeting deadlines with a positive attitude and eagerness to learn
- Excellent written and verbal communication ability
- Experience in health and wellness is a plus and passion for what we do is a must. Experience with physical locations is helpful.

**Responsibilities:**

- Contribute to organic strategy in partnership with the Head of Marketing.
- Own execution and project management of all organic marketing programs including email, organic social, referral, influencer, partnerships, and events
- Track paid and organic marketing campaign performance in tandem with our agency partners while synthesizing clear and concise learnings to create a compelling brand and product narrative
- Work with Head of Marketing and creative partners to ideate innovative campaigns which drive acquisition and define a new category within healthcare / wellness
- Lead project management of all creative asset production; partner with internal, agency and freelance team members to generate engaging, on brand content quickly and within budget
- Think strategically, creatively and analytically to identify new demand generation programs
- Shape the long-term marketing roadmap, identifying opportunities to define BeSound as a thought leader in wellness and healthcare innovation

# Senior Accounting/Payroll Specialist (Queens)

Location:Flushing, NYCompany:Wiss

## Description:

**Position Overview:**

A privately held construction client is seeking a hands-on accounting professional with a strong background in union payroll and general accounting. This individual will be responsible for managing union payroll activities while supporting the company's day-to-day accounting operations, month-end close, and financial reporting.

The ideal candidate will have experience working for a construction contractor, understand the complexities of union payroll and related compliance requirements, and be comfortable taking ownership of both payroll and accounting responsibilities in a hands-on environment.

**Key Responsibilities**:

• Process and oversee weekly union payroll for construction employees, ensuring accurate and timely payments.

• Maintain a strong understanding of union agreements, prevailing wage requirements where applicable, and applicable payroll regulations.

• Prepare and review union payroll reports, certified payroll documentation where required, and related filings.

• Calculate and reconcile union benefits, fringe benefits, dues, deductions, and contributions to applicable benefit funds.

• Maintain accurate employee payroll records, hours, job classifications, and labor allocations.

• Reconcile payroll accounts and investigate discrepancies between payroll records, job costs, and the general ledger.

• Coordinate with union representatives, benefit funds, employees, and external providers to resolve payroll-related questions and discrepancies.

• Ensure payroll processes comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements.

• Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations, including accruals, prepaids, and fixed assets.

• Support month-end close by completing assigned reconciliations and maintaining supporting documentation.

• Review general ledger activity, investigate variances, and coordinate corrections.

• Assist with audits, management reporting, and process documentation.

• Support accounting for intercompany transactions and foreign entities, as applicable.

• Assist with bank reconciliations and recording routine cash transactions.

• Support other accounting and reporting needs as they arise.

**Qualifications:**

• Prior experience in construction accounting with hands-on union payroll processing or oversight.

• Understanding of union payroll requirements, fringe benefits, deductions, and payroll-related compliance.

• General accounting experience, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and month-end close.

• Experience reconciling payroll activity to the general ledger and, ideally, job cost records.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

• Comfortable working onsite in a hands-on role within a growing construction business.

• Experience with Sage 100 or similar accounting systems is helpful; specific payroll software experience is not a determining factor.

**Compensation:**

• Competitive base salary of $100,000–$110,000.

• Fully onsite, five days per week in Queens, NY.

**To all staffing agencies**: Wiss does not utilize 3rd party firms for any internal or client positions. Please be advised, Wiss is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. All unsolicited resumes will become the property of Wiss.

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Brooklyn)

Location:Flatbush, NYCompany:Liberty Home Guard

## Description:

**Title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Paid Search, Paid Social, Video & Attribution)**

**The Impact You Will Have:**

Liberty Home Guard is the country's fastest-growing and best-rated home warranty provider, named U.S. News Best Home Warranty Company Overall for 2026-27. We are seeking a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own the strategy, execution, and measurement of our paid acquisition program across paid search (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), paid social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and similar platforms), digital video (YouTube), and Connected TV (CTV) bought programmatically through a demand-side platform. Paid search is the foundation of the program; CTV, paid social, and video are how we build demand above it, and multi-touch attribution is how we hold every channel to the same standard. This is a hands-on role for a marketer who is equally comfortable inside an ad account and inside a spreadsheet: someone who has managed substantial budgets, treats attribution and incrementality as core parts of the job rather than reporting afterthoughts, and stays ahead of a rapidly changing paid media landscape.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns, has bought and optimized Connected TV through a DSP, has run paid social and video campaigns, has successfully overseen six-figure monthly advertising budgets, and understands how to drive measurable growth while maintaining strong return on ad spend (ROAS). This person will also own our multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros) and will be the one the leadership team relies on to answer what is actually working. Home services or home warranty industry experience is a significant advantage.

The right candidate is both strategic and highly tactical: passionate about performance marketing, energized by testing and learning, and comfortable making data-driven decisions that directly affect business growth. You will manage the day-to-day optimization of campaigns across every paid channel and lead the larger strategic work of helping multiple service lines grow through paid media. In practice, you will be the marketing team's quantitative expert: the owner of how we measure, attribute, and evaluate every paid dollar we spend.

**Your duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:**

- Develop, execute, and optimize paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other relevant platforms.
- Manage monthly paid media budgets exceeding $100,000 across search, social, and video while maximizing lead quality, conversion volume, and return on investment.
- Create and execute campaign strategies across multiple service lines, geographic markets, and business objectives.
- Continuously monitor campaign performance, identifying opportunities to improve CTR, Quality Score, conversion rates, CPL, CPA, and ROAS.
- Conduct ongoing keyword research, competitive analysis, audience segmentation, and bidding optimization.
- Build and test ad copy, creative, landing page recommendations, audience strategies, and campaign structures through disciplined A/B and holdout testing.
- Analyze performance data using Hyros, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and other reporting tools.
- Stay current on emerging search trends, AI-driven search experiences, automation, Performance Max, changes in Google's advertising ecosystem, developments across paid social and streaming video platforms, and evolving best practices.
- Collaborate with SEO, creative, web development, sales, and leadership teams to ensure integrated digital marketing strategies.
- Produce clear reporting and actionable insights for leadership with recommendations for continued growth.
- Ensure accurate conversion tracking, offline and phone-sale conversion imports, attribution, and campaign measurement across all paid channels.
- Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), extending to TikTok, Pinterest, and similar platforms as the business warrants.
- Plan, launch, and optimize digital video campaigns on YouTube, including audience definition, creative sequencing, and view-through and search-lift measurement.
- Own our Connected TV program end to end: manage buys through our CTV demand-side platform partner, define household and geographic targeting against our customer profile, set reach and frequency goals, manage publisher and app inventory mix, rotate and test creative, and control pacing and spend.
- Measure CTV on incrementality rather than platform attribution: design and read geo holdouts and ghost-bid tests, track branded search and direct traffic lift on a lag, reconcile vendor readouts against our own CRM and analytics data, and make scale, hold, or pause recommendations on that evidence.
- Own our multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros): maintain the tracking implementation and cost-data integrations, audit data integrity, and produce journey-level reporting on cost per acquisition, ROAS, and lead-to-sale conversion by channel.
- Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, ghost bids, platform lift studies) for upper-funnel channels, and distinguish true incremental contribution from platform-attributed results before budget decisions are made.
- Build and maintain the weekly and monthly paid performance reporting framework for leadership, and serve as the team's quantitative authority on what is working, what is not, and why.
- Manage relationships with media platforms, agency partners, and measurement vendors, and evaluate new channel and vendor proposals against a consistent measurement standard.

**Requirements:**

- 5+ years of hands-on PPC/Paid Search experience managing performance marketing campaigns.
- Proven success managing monthly paid media budgets of $100,000+.
- Deep expertise with Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and Meta Ads Manager.
- Strong understanding of bidding strategies, attribution models and their limitations, incrementality measurement, audience targeting, conversion optimization, and campaign automation.
- Experience managing campaigns across multiple brands, business units, or service lines simultaneously.
- Exceptional analytical skills, with the statistical judgment to separate real performance changes from noise and turn data into decisions.
- Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for modeling and analysis, including building auditable, formula-driven reports.
- Excellent communication and project management skills.
- Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
- Hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns, Meta at minimum, with TikTok or Pinterest a plus.
- Hands-on experience planning, buying, and optimizing Connected TV campaigns through a demand-side platform (for example Vibe, The Trade Desk, StackAdapt, MNTN, or comparable), including household targeting, frequency management, inventory selection, and creative rotation.
- Working understanding of how CTV is measured: view-through and impression-to-visit attribution, branded search and direct traffic lift, geo holdout and lift-study design, and the limits of platform-reported results.
- Experience managing YouTube or other digital video campaigns alongside search and social.
- Experience implementing and operating a multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros, Northbeam, Triple Whale, or comparable), including pixel and server-side tracking and cost-data integrations.
- Experience designing or interpreting incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) and communicating results clearly to non-technical leadership.

**Preferred (nice to have):**

- Home services or home warranty marketing experience strongly preferred (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, restoration, pest control, garage doors, landscaping, etc.).
- Experience generating high-volume lead generation campaigns.
- Familiarity with CRM integrations, call tracking platforms, and offline conversion tracking, particularly for phone-led sales models.
- Experience with Local Services Ads (LSAs).
- Experience with AI-powered campaign optimization tools and automation workflows.
- Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for data analysis.
- Experience running CTV alongside a brand search program and quantifying the relationship between the two.
- Familiarity with CTV and streaming inventory sources (Hulu, Tubi, Pluto TV, Roku, Sling, Peacock and similar) and their audience profiles.
- Experience producing or briefing 15- and 30-second video creative for TV and streaming placements.
- Familiarity with media mix modeling or marketing econometrics.

**Pay Rate:** $110K - $135K annually.

# Senior Accounts Payable Specialist

Location:Rowland Heights, CACompany:Chubby Group

## Description:

Job DescriptionJob Description

Chubby Cattle International is seeking an experienced Senior Accounts Payable & Finance Operations Specialist to join our growing Finance team in Los Angeles.

As our restaurant group continues to expand across the U.S., this position will support accounts payable, inventory management, month-end close, restaurant finance operations, and financial systems across 50+ locations.

We are especially interested in candidates who have experience with Craftable, Restaurant365 (R365), MarginEdge, MarketMan, or other restaurant inventory/AP management systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

Accounts Payable & Invoice Processing

- Manage high-volume invoice processing across multiple restaurant locations and entities
- Manage invoice mapping, bill approvals, invoice processing, and payment reconciliation within Craftable
- Review invoice coding, approvals, supporting documentation, and payment status
- Reconcile vendor statements and resolve missing invoices, credits, duplicate charges, and payment discrepancies
- Maintain vendor records and support new vendor setup

Month-End Close

- Support the AP-side month-end close process, including invoice completeness checks, expense review, and reconciliations
- Coordinate with restaurant managers to ensure invoices and month-end documentation are submitted accurately and on time

Banking & Payment Operations

- Process vendor payments and assist with internal transfers and wire submissions
- Support account monitoring, banking administration, and account information updates
- Support reconciliation and documentation related to banking and payment activity

**Qualifications**

- 3+ years of Accounts Payable or Accounting experience preferred
- Restaurant, hospitality, multi-unit retail, or other high-volume multi-location experience strongly preferred
- Experience with Craftable preferred. Experience with Restaurant365, MarginEdge, MarketMan, or similar platforms is also highly valued
- Strong understanding of AP workflows, invoice coding, vendor reconciliation, and month-end close
- Experience supporting multiple locations or legal entities preferred
- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a high volume of transactions and deadlines
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, rapidly growing restaurant organization

**About Chubby Cattle International**

Chubby Cattle International is a fast-growing multi-brand restaurant group with locations across the United States. As we continue expanding our restaurant portfolio, we are building a strong centralized Finance and Operations infrastructure to support our growing teams and locations.

If you have high-volume AP experience and enjoy keeping a fast-moving operation accurate and on time, we’d love to hear from you.

# Vice President, Institutional Channel Marketing Manager (Data & Audience-Led)

PIMCO Newport Beach, United States

Apply now Save

PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients' capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world's largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

**Position Description**

We are seeking a **Vice President, Institutional Channel Marketing Manager** to join our data-driven, audience-first team. This role will shape and execute modern marketing strategies that drive measurable business outcomes-accelerating revenue growth, deepening client engagement, and enhancing brand relevance across U.S. Institutional and Insurance segments.

The ideal candidate combines strategic marketing leadership with strong analytics fluency, bringing a deep understanding of institutional audiences, investment products, and distribution ecosystems. You will champion a segmentation- based approach, leveraging data, insights, and technology to deliver highly targeted, personalized experiences at scale.

This is a high-impact role for a forward-thinking leader who can connect audience strategy, content, and performance analytics, turning marketing into a disciplined, insights-led growth function.

**Responsibilities**

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Audience Strategy & Growth Marketing**

- Define and operationalize a segmentation and audience development framework, leveraging firmographic, behavioral, and engagement data to drive precision targeting.
- Partner with sales and client management to evolve Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and growth marketing strategies that balance scale (pipeline generation) and precision (high-value client conversion).
- Build and optimize full-funnel marketing journeys, ensuring coordinated messaging from awareness through conversion and retention.

**Data, Analytics & Measurement Leadership**

- Establish a data-driven marketing operating model, defining KPIs aligned to business outcomes (engagement, pipeline, revenue contribution).
- Own performance measurement across channels (email, web, paid media, events), translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and narratives for stakeholders.
- Partner with analytics and data teams to enhance dashboards, attribution models, and lifecycle scoring frameworks to improve decision-making.
- Lead a culture of test-and-learn experimentation (A/B testing, cohort analysis, incrementality testing) to continuously optimize marketing impact.

**Channel Strategy & Orchestration**

- Develop integrated channel strategies that align digital, content, and client-facing efforts into cohesive, orchestrated programs.
- Drive consistency in audience targeting, messaging, and measurement across all channels, reducing fragmentation and improving efficiency.
- Optimize channel mix and investment strategies based on performance insights and ROI analysis.

**Content & Personalization**

- Translate investment insights and thought leadership into audience-centric, actionable content strategies tailored by segment, lifecycle stage, and channel.
- Champion personalization at scale, ensuring relevance through dynamic content, targeted outreach, and data-informed messaging.
- Partner with global content and digital teams to ensure consistency, quality, and scalability of content delivery.

**Marketing Programs & Campaign Leadership**

- Design and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns aligned to audience segments and strategic priorities.
- Lead lifecycle-based programs (always-on nurture, trigger campaigns, thematic initiatives) that drive sustained engagement.
- Ensure campaigns are measurable, optimized, and connected, moving beyond isolated channel execution to holistic performance.

**Commercial Alignment & Stakeholder Engagement**

- Serve as a strategic partner to Institutional and Insurance client-facing teams, aligning marketing efforts to client needs, sales priorities, and pipeline goals.
- Deliver compelling performance narratives and insights that influence business decisions and resource allocation.
- Strengthen feedback loops between marketing and sales to continuously refine targeting and messaging.

**Innovation, Martech & Optimization**

- Leverage marketing technology (CRM, marketing automation, analytics platforms) to enhance audience targeting, personalization, and measurement.
- Identify opportunities to integrate AI and advanced analytics into marketing workflows (segmentation, content optimization, predictive insights).
- Continuously evolve marketing processes to improve scalability, speed, and efficiency.

**Team Leadership & Culture**

- Mentor and develop a high-performing team with strong capabilities in data-driven marketing, audience strategy, and digital execution.
- Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
- Embody PIMCO's CORE Values - Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree required; CAIA, CFA, or other industry designation preferred.
- 10+ years of experience in institutional marketing, channel marketing, or growth marketing within asset management or financial services.
- Demonstrated expertise in audience segmentation, lifecycle marketing, and ABM strategies.
- Strong analytical mindset with proven ability to **translate data into business insights and actions.**
- Experience with marketing analytics, reporting tools, and MarTech platforms (e.g., CRM, marketing automation, dashboards).
- Deep understanding of institutional client segments (e.g., DB, insurance, consultants) and investment products (particularly fixed income and alternatives).
- Proven ability to lead integrated, multi-channel marketing programs.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders through **data-backed storytelling.**

**Required Capabilities**

- Proven ability to build and sustain strong relationships with clients and senior stakeholders; communicates effectively, exercises sound judgment, and builds trust through integrity and discretion.
- Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills; able to navigate ambiguity, translate strategy into action, and independently drive outcomes.
- Experience leveraging data, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to inform decision-making, improve efficiency, and deliver scalable solutions.
- Highly organized and execution-oriented, with strong project management skills; effectively manages competing priorities, drives accountability, closes loops, and maintains a "no job too small" mindset.
- Thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments; quickly absorbs context, adapts to changing priorities, and demonstrates a strong bias for action.
- Collaborative, resilient, and emotionally intelligent; builds productive partnerships across teams while remaining effective under pressure.
- Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to enhance processes, increase efficiency, and improve business outcomes.
- Maintains the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and ethics, particularly when handling sensitive or confidential information.
- Intellectually curious, with a genuine interest in financial markets and a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development.

# Administrative Coordinator

A Plus Tree, Inc

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/172955662021845519?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8386397275009291338&crId=US_0US_0)

The Administrative Coordinator is the primary in-office support for client documents, sales operations, contracts and compliance documentation, and executive leadership. This role keeps documents organized, deadlines on track, and internal partners informed while representing A Plus Tree’s 6 DONEs in all communication.
This position is entry-level, full-time, hourly, non-exempt. Monday through Friday, in office/in person, in Sacramento, CA.
Percentage of Time Spent:
35% Client Docs Email & Contract Management
20% Certificate of Insurance, W9s, Bonds & Compliance Documents
15% Business Licensing & Vehicle Registrations / DMV Support
Responsibilities:
Client Docs & Contract Management
Manage the Client Docs inbox as the central intake point for contracts and related documentation.
Oversee the full contract lifecycle from intake through execution and internal filing.
Maintain accurate records inArborPlusand shared drives so sales and operations can easily access current documents.
COIs, W9s, Bonds & Compliance
Coordinate COI and W9 requests and ensure client documentation requirements are met quickly and accurately.
Support bond and other compliance document workflows in partnership with Sales and our insurance/bonding partners.
Keep compliance documentation organized and accessible for internal stakeholders and clients.
Business Licensing & Vehicle Registrations / DMV
Track and support city and state business license applications and renewals.
Coordinate the collection and filing of vehicle registration and DMV documentation.
Ensurelicensing and registration records are current and properly stored.
Provide administrative support to Sales and Project Coordinators related to contracts, licenses, and client documentation.
Assist with vendor setup, pre-qualification materials, and portal registrations.
Support bid and RFP submissions by organizing and uploading required documentation.
Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Executive Leadership Team, including travel coordination, expenses, and basic scheduling support.
Handle incoming mail, scanning, routing, and filing of key documents.
Maintain an organized office environment and support occasional in-person errands or special projects.
Qualifications:
Required:
1–3 years of experience in administrative, project coordination, or office support roles.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel, and comfort learning company software and portals.

##### Patient Service Representative

Artificial Intelligence; Advanced Technology; The very best in patient care. With decades of expertise, we are Leading Radiology Forward. With dynamic cross-training and advancement opportunities in a team-focused environment, the core of our success is its people with the commitment to a better healthcare experience. When you join us as a Patient Service Representative, you will be joining a dedicated team of professionals who deliver quality, value, and access in the 21st century and align all stakeholders- patients, providers, payors, and regulators to achieve the best clinical outcomes.

You Will:

- Greet and register patients in a friendly and service-oriented manner.
- Obtain or verify proper insurance and patient information, collect signatures and ensure accuracy and completion of necessary documentation.
- Collect and log all co-pays and fees
- Answer/transfer incoming phone calls.
- Schedule, reschedule or cancel new or current patients, confirm appointments and notify staff of changes when necessary.
- Give patients appropriate orientation for preparatory and safety protocols, and provide directions to facilities if needed.
- Coordinate with the back-office staff for timely and effective care of patients
- Demonstrates competency regarding the need to safeguard patient property and Patient Health Information.
- Safeguards any on site medications in accordance with Company policies, procedures and any legal requirements.
- Demonstrates respect for company property, including any cash and patient financial information on site or on patient portals.
- Is responsive to the needs of others by exhibiting and maintaining professional behavior toward patients and coworkers.
- Demonstrates respect for patient boundaries and cultural sensitivities during all interactions.
- Demonstrates ability to interact diplomatically and sympathetically with patients, their families, and the public in a clinical setting.
- Demonstrates ability to establish, nurture, and maintain cooperative working relationships.

You Are:

- Genuinely passionate about customer service and exercise sound judgement and an ability to remain professional in all situations
- Able to demonstrate effective and professional communication, interpersonal skills and respect with patients, guests & colleagues
- Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, have a knack for prioritizing work with a structured approach, and enjoy providing world-class customer service

To Ensure Success In This Role, You Must Have:

- High School Diploma or GED
- Intermediate to advanced computer skills
- Strong multitasking and communication skills
- Experience providing exceptional customer service
- Medical terminology knowledge and recent medical/radiology office experience is preferred.

We Offer:

- Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision coverages.
- Health Savings Accounts with employer funding.
- Wellness dollars
- 401(k) Employer Match
- Free services at any of our imaging centers for you and your immediate family.

Pay Rate: $23.00 - $26.00 / Per Hour

# Master Scheduler - Semiconductor Manufacturing

MTK Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1978196729334258928?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4990466002197878038&crId=US_0US_0)

Location: Bay Area, CA (Remote Considered for Exceptional Candidates)

Work Arrangement: Onsite Preferred; Remote Considered for Highly Qualified Candidates

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Master Scheduler to join our client in the semiconductor industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing the Master Production Schedule (MPS) to align customer demand with manufacturing capacity, inventory objectives, and delivery commitments.

Reporting to the Manager of Global Planning, this professional will collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Engineering, and Sales Operations teams to ensure efficient production planning, resource utilization, and on-time delivery across multiple product lines and manufacturing facilities.

Key Responsibilities

Master Production Scheduling: Develop, maintain, and communicate the Master Production Schedule (MPS) across product lines and manufacturing facilities.

Demand and Inventory Planning: Align production schedules with demand forecasts, customer requirements, inventory targets, and business priorities.

Capacity Planning: Analyze manufacturing capacity, resource availability, and production constraints to identify scheduling risks and implement mitigation strategies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Engineering, and Sales Operations teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and maintain production continuity.

Production Coordination: Coordinate production priorities, product configurations, and scheduling requirements to support customer commitments and manufacturing objectives.

New Product Introduction (NPI): Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to incorporate new product introductions and changing production requirements into scheduling plans.

Performance Monitoring: Track production schedule adherence, on-time delivery, capacity utilization, and other key performance indicators (KPIs).

Reporting and Analytics: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and scheduling metrics to communicate production status, capacity constraints, and potential delivery risks to leadership.

ERP/MRP Systems: Utilize Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems to support production planning, scheduling, and inventory management.

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve scheduling accuracy, operational efficiency, resource utilization, and overall supply chain performance.

Required Qualifications

Experience in master scheduling, production planning, manufacturing planning, or supply chain planning.

Knowledge of Master Production Scheduling (MPS), demand forecasting, capacity planning, and inventory management.

Experience working with ERP/MRP systems and production planning tools.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.

Experience monitoring production KPIs, schedule adherence, and on-time delivery performance.

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a manufacturing environment.

Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing industry.

Experience supporting multiple product lines or manufacturing facilities.

Familiarity with production planning dashboards, reporting tools, and data analytics.

Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing capacity optimization.

Knowledge of supply chain planning best practices and continuous improvement methodologies.

# Substitute-Administrative Assistant II Continuous Applicant Pool

$58.41k

Imperial Valley College

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3396122245450280256?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2239792208779556321&crId=US_0US_0)

Substitute-Administrative Assistant II Continuous Applicant Pool
Salary: $58,406.40 Annually

Job Type: Classified Substitute

Job Number: SUB-AAII

Closing: Continuous

Location: 380 East Aten Road, Imperial, CA

Division: Classified Temporary

Representative Duties

## BASIC FUNCTION

Under direction of a Director, the Administrative Assistant II provides a variety of responsible and confidential administrative duties and oversees the proper functioning of all administrative activities under their assigned area of responsibility, including coordination of communication for the Office.

## DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS

This classification is a mid-level administrative position in the series of administrative classifications requiring an increased level of competency in communication, judgement, confidentiality, working independently, discretion, administrative skills, and governing rules and regulations applicable to the department or service area they are supporting.

## ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

01. Provide administrative assistance to the Associate Dean or Director by coordinating and maintaining the calendar to schedule meetings, events, appointments, and workshops.
02. Organize and coordinate the flow of activities through the office in relation to priorities, schedules, and deadlines; perform administrative duties for the Associate Dean or Director.
03. Research and analyze information and data; prepare and submit reports; maintain files and records.
04. Acts as an information resource regarding policies and procedures of assigned area responsibility; coordinate and track the review and updating of relevant department policies, procedures, and processes; maintain webpage for assigned area of responsibility.
05. Assemble, prepare, review, and submit Board agenda items and supplemental materials for assigned area of responsibility to appropriate divisional level. Assist and coordinate with the appropriate Administrative Assistant or Vice President's Executive Assistant as required.
06. Prepare correspondence and reports for the Associate Dean or Director, screen, and route incoming correspondence. Compose and prepare responses to correspondence and requests for public records.
07. Coordinate and prepare all necessary materials and documents in preparation for participatory governance and committee meetings; Prepare meeting agenda and take meeting notes and minutes as assigned.
08. Perform and manage administrative related projects and processes unique to assigned area of responsibility, i.e. recruitment, accreditation, program review, special events and activities, reports, and special programs.
09. Monitor, provide work direction, and supervise student employees assigned to the office.
10. Coordinate and train department staff in their area of responsibility for department administrative policies, procedures, and processes as needed.
11. Act as a liaison for the Associate Dean or Director; promote and maintain positive staff relations; screen incoming calls; greet visitors; maintain positive relations with employees and community. Answer inquiries, provide information, address complaints, and offer referrals to appropriate sources.
12. Arrange meeting and event services for the Associate Dean or Director's office such as reception coordination, planning logistics, and providing materials.
13. Compile and prepare federal, State and County reports as assigned; keep informed of pertinent laws, policies, and pending legislation.
14. Propose and administer the budget of the Associate Dean or Director's Office. Process purchase orders as required.
15. Plan and make travel arrangements and process travel claims as assigned.
16. Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Perform related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications
High School graduate or equivalent and two (2) years of administrative related experience.

Certificates, Licenses, Special Requirements
Certain assignments may require a valid California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the district's vehicle insurance program.

Important: To be considered for the position applying for, applicants must submit the required items by the deadline, which include: online IVC application, current resume, and ALL unofficial transcripts. All attachments will be uploaded into the online application. Applications which do not include all of the required materials will not be forwarded to the screening committee for consideration. Materials submitted become property of the District and will not be returned, copied, or considered for other openings.

## COMMITMENT TO EQUITY AND DIVERSITY

With the goal of ensuring the equal educational opportunity of all students, Imperial Valley College embraces diversity among students, faculty, staff, and the communities we serve as an integral part of our history, a recognition of the complexity of our present state, and a call to action for a better future. Embracing diversity means that we must intentionally practice equity and respect toward one another, and understand that discrimination and prejudices create and sustain privileges for some while creating and sustaining barriers for others. In order to embrace diversity, we also acknowledge that institutional discrimination and implicit bias exist, and that our goal is to eradicate those vestiges from our system. Our commitment to diversity requires that we strive to eliminate those barriers to equity, and that we act deliberately to create a safe and positive environment where individual and group differences are valued and leveraged for our growth and understanding as an educational community.

To advance the goals of diversity, equity, inclusion, and social justice for the success of students and employees, we must honor that each individual is unique and that our individual differences contribute to the ability of the college to prepare students on their educational journeys. This requires that we develop and implement policies and procedures, encourage individual and systemic change, continually reflect on our efforts, and hold ourselves accountable for the results of our efforts in accomplishing our goals.

We are invested as a community in cultivating and maintaining a climate where equity and mutual respect are both intrinsic and explicit by valuing individuals and groups from all backgrounds, demographics, and experiences. Individual and group differences can include, but are not limited to the following dimensions: race, ethnicity, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, immigration status, sex, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, religion, creed, military or veteran status, socioeconomic status, and any other basis protected by federal, state or local law or ordinance or regulation. We acknowledge that the concept of inclusion and diversity is ever-evolving, thus we create space to allow our understanding to grow through the periodic review of this statement. In service of these goals, Imperial Valley College is committed to fostering an employment environment that offers equal employment opportunity for all and an educational environment that ensures the equal educational opportunity of all students.

## THE COLLEGE

Imperial Valley College is co-recipient of the 2023 Aspen Award for Community College Excellence. It offers a full range of associate degrees, professional certificates and basic skills courses as well as a comprehensive array of university transfer and education courses. IVC has an annual full-time enrollment of more than 10,000 students. The Aspen award committee noted that IVC has created one of the nation's most effective partnerships with local K-12 systems and has excelled in graduation rates and post‑graduation success of its student population. Its student success is based upon IVC's work in eliminating barriers, addressing student challenges and fostering a culture of care in a rural area with high rates of poverty and traditionally low rates of educational attainment. Imperial Valley College is known throughout the region for its outstanding career programs, excellent programs of study in business, quality allied health, renewable energy and public safety programs and for excellent transfer and general education courses. IVC is also a major economic engine in Imperial County. It is responsible for infusing millions of dollars annually into the local economy through its construction projects, general operations and annual earnings of its current students and graduates. THERE IS ONE VACANCY BEING ADVERTISED ACROSS MULTIPLE COUNTIES. THE INCUMBENT WILL BE HEADQUARTERED IN THE COUNTY NEAREST THE RESIDENCE OF THE SELECTED CANDIDATE. THE COUNTIES ARE: \* Contra Costa or Sacramento County \*

This position supports the California Department of Public Health's (CDPH) mission and strategic plan by supporting health equity, emergency preparedness, data modernization and innovative process improvements, and fostering professional development within the department, ensuring that CDPH remains resilient, inclusive, and impactful in its efforts to protect and improve public health outcomes for all Californians.

Under the close supervision of the Office of Infectious Disease Preparedness and Response (OIDPR) Public Health Medical Administrator II (Office Chief), the Student Assistant will assist with a variety of administrative, technical, and project-related assignments in a learning capacity. The position requires effective oral and written communication skills and provides support to the OIDPR Office Chief and Assistant Chiefs through meeting and event coordination, presentation development, information gathering, and administrative support activities. The incumbent supports the use of emerging technologies and business tools, including AI Copilot and SharePoint, to enhance operational efficiency and improve business processes. Additional responsibilities include supporting procurement and service order activities, maintaining office records and documentation, assisting with customer service and triage functions, coordinating communications, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that support OIDPR operations.

This non-tenured intermittent position will be limited to working up to 1,500 hours in a 12-consecutive month period.

We are seeking a polished, friendly, and dependable Receptionist for a direct hire opportunity in Sacramento, CA. Sellrbox is growing fast, and our founders need an exceptional Executive Assistant to help them stay focused on what matters most. This role is the operational backbone of the leadership team.
You'll manage complex calendars, coordinate cross-timezone meetings between our US and China-based teams, handle travel logistics, and keep the gears of a fast-moving company turning smoothly. The best EAs don't just manage schedules. They anticipate needs and create leverage.
This is a high-trust role with direct access to the founding team. You'll see everything, know everything, and be trusted to handle it all with discretion and excellence.
In this role, you will… Manage executive calendars across US and Asia time zones, ensuring the founders' time is spent on the highest-impact activities
Coordinate travel and events from client meetings to team offsites, handling every detail
Serve as a communications hub triaging inbound requests, drafting responses, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks
Bridge cross-cultural communication between our US-based leadership and China-based operations, ensuring smooth collaboration across teams
Own special projects that require cross-functional coordination: vendor sourcing, team events, supplier negotiations
Build operational systems that scale with the company: templates, workflows, and processes that create leverage
You'll be a great fit if you… You're exceptionally organized. You have systems for everything. Nothing gets lost, nothing gets forgotten.
You anticipate needs. You don't wait to be asked. You see what's coming and prepare for it.
You communicate with precision. Clear, concise, professional. Fluent in both English and Mandarin, with strong written skills in both.
You're discreet. You'll have access to sensitive information. Trust and confidentiality are non-negotiable.
You thrive in fast-paced environments. Priorities change quickly at a growing company. You adapt without missing a beat.
You're tech-savvy. Comfortable with modern tools such as Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, and calendar management apps. You learn new tools quickly.
What it means to join the team... Direct access to the founding team and visibility into all aspects of the business
High-trust, high-autonomy role where your judgment matters
Opportunity to grow as the company grows
Honest, low-ego team that values operational excellence
100% remote with flexible schedule
Comp: Competitive and commensurate with experience

Our remote team spans multiple countries and is growing fast. We combine deep e-commerce operations knowledge with cutting-edge AI to build tools like Astra, our intelligent advertising platform, that give sellers a genuine competitive edge.

The Picklr - Rancho Cordova

[Rancho Cordova, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Rancho-Cordova%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/739666380334356070?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7222&pageType=7&jobAge=450&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7446538903927399365&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Company Overview**

The Picklr is positioned to be one of the most influential voices in pickleball and is already the industry leader of indoor clubs. A recent partnership with the Professional Pickleball Association means the best players in the world now train and instruct at The Picklr. The Picklr owns Stack Athletics, one of the fastest-growing pickleball apparel brands. The Stack Pro team has some of the most recognizable names in the sport and elevates short-court style with a youthful approach. The Picklr has part ownership of a professional MLP team. Pickleball is the fastest-growing sport in the world, and The Picklr is meeting the demand for the ultimate pickleball experience with an inspiring, athlete-driven brand. If you’re ready to work hard and play hard, come join our team.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for passionate individuals who are self-motivated and love working with people for our Front Desk Coordinator position. The Front Desk Coordinator would be responsible for answering phones, checking members in for their reservations, league hosting, maintaining facility cleanliness, and helping resolve concerns on the spot. You would get the opportunity to work closely with the members and help provide them with a positive experience at the Picklr.

Desired Availability- Morning, Mid Day, and Weekends.

**Responsibilities**

- Answer phone calls and messages that come into the club
- Greet and check in members for their reservations
- Assist with keeping the club clean and orderly at all times
- Provide members with the best experience possible
- Host Leagues
- Participate in marketing opportunities as requested

**Roles**

A brief description of different types of hats (roles) a Front Desk Coordinator is able and willing to wear at any given time.

**Role #1 - Welcome and check in**

- Greeting and Welcoming guests as soon as they arrive
- Check in members and guests, collect/add payment prior to use of the club
- Review transactions on a weekly basis
- Assist guests with memberships, and members with event registration and reservations

**Role #2 - Customer service**

- Stay near the front desk to assist when people enter the club
- No messages left unread at the end of each shift
- Answer/complete phone calls
- Accommodate daily questions members/guest may have
- Maintain a high level of cleanliness throughout each shift: _(Includes but not limited to)_
- (a) Refill toilet paper, hand towels, and soap if needed
- (b) Empty garbage cans
- (c) Clean Locker Rooms
- (d) Maintain floor and furniture
- (e) Court Cleaning

**Role #3 - Program Facilitation and Operation**

Correctly run and facilitate the various programs that occur during your shift.

Open play:

- Make sure previous groups have cleared the courts
- Check people in and process payments
- Answer questions about open play rotation
- Clean up after the event

Leagues:

- All court assignments will be prepared for you by the club coordinator - please stick to the sheets
- Put two balls and clipboard with court assignments in each of the used court baskets
- Answer any questions regarding upcoming leagues or the league format
- Collect clipboards and balls from all the used courts after the event
- League hosting and facilitation (ensure flow of program is steady, keep score, engage with members, dink warm ups, etc)

**Role #4 - Membership Sales and Marketing**

- Promote the club and membership opportunities
- Know the membership well enough to sell over the phone, in the club, or in public
- Complete the Member Retention Program during each shift
- Support internal and external marketing opportunities

**Qualifications and Skills**

- Experience in customer service
- Experience with technology
- Pickleball Experience

**Company Benefits and Perks**

- Company culture and company activities
- Career growth opportunities
- Membership discounts

Compensation

Part-time position. Hourly.
