**Overview**

Kimley-Horn is looking for an Accounting Assistant to join our growing regional Project Accounting team in our Sacramento, California (CA) office! This is an office-based role.

**Responsibilities**

The ideal candidate would be able to work in a fast-paced collaborative team setting and communicate effectively to achieve group goals. This individual would work closely with accounting team members to support full project lifecycle business functions.

- Support Project Accountants with business-related tasks for both internal and external client requests

- Prepare and send monthly invoices that may require expense backup, timesheet detail, pay applications, or other client-specific invoicing requirements

- Partner with Project Accountants to monitor and follow-up on unpaid invoices to collect accounts receivable balances

- Work closely with accounting team members to support full project lifecycle business functions

- Monitor and collect accounts receivable by working directly with clients

- Evaluate incoming payments to ensure proper cash application

- Process accounts payable, overhead invoices, check requests, and respond to vendor inquiries

- Cash receipt backup

- Data entry directly into internal and external accounting systems

- Review client contracts to ensure accurate project setup

- Electronic contract and document management

- Assist with other general accounting support functions as required


**Qualifications**

- High school diploma or equivalent

- 1+ years of relevant accounting experience or coursework

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

- High degree of professionalism and strong people skills

- Excellent team player

- Ability to multi-task and work effectively in a deadline driven environment

- Effective oral and written communication skills

- Deltek CostPoint proficiency is a plus


Salary Range: **$52,000-$67,000**

**Why Kimley-Horn?**

At Kimley-Horn, we do things differently. People, clients, and employees are at the forefront of who we are. Clients know we prioritize achieving their goals and growing their success. Employees know our culture and approach to business are built on a desire to provide an environment for everyone to flourish. Our commitment to quality is only as good as the people behind it- that's why we welcome and develop passionate, hardworking, and proactive employees. We take pride in how our employee retention, robust benefits package, and company values have led to Kimley-Horn's placement on the Fortune "100 Best Companies to Work" list for 19 years!

_Key Benefits at Kimley-Horn_

- Exceptional Retirement Plan: 2-to1- company match on up to 4% of eligible compensation (salary + bonus) and additional profit-sharing contribution.

- Comprehensive Health Coverage: Low-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

- Time Off: Personal leave, flexible scheduling, floating holidays, and half-day Fridays.

- Financial Wellness: Student loan matching in our 401(k), and performance-based bonuses.

- Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement and extensive internal training programs.

- Family-Friendly Benefits: New Parent Leave, family building benefits, and childcare resources.

Now Hiring: Accounting & Payroll Specialist

**Location:**
Location: City of Industry, CA 91748

**Industry:**
Industry: Electrical / Electronic Manufacturing

**Education:**
Education: High School Diploma or GED

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Accounting & Payroll Specialist to manage full-cycle, multistate payroll processing while supporting general accounting and financial operations. The ideal candidate will have hands‑on experience with biweekly payroll, payroll compliance, general ledger accounting, journal entries, and account reconciliations.

This role requires strong attention to detail, knowledge of multistate payroll regulations, and the ability to maintain accurate payroll and financial records across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities
Payroll Administration

Manage full-cycle, biweekly payroll processing for multiple locations across different states.

Review and validate timecards, attendance records, payroll adjustments, and employee information.

Process manual checks, off-cycle payments, deductions, garnishments, tax levies, and child support orders.

Reconcile payroll reports, maintain accurate records, and prepare payroll-related journal entries.

Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local payroll laws and wage-and-hour regulations.

Coordinate payroll tax filings, W-2 processing, and year-end reconciliations.

Maintain accurate payroll data in payroll software, HRIS, and ERP systems.

Assist with general ledger maintenance, journal entries, and account reconciliations.

Support accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) activities.

Assist with month-end closing and financial reporting.

Support the preparation and review of profit and loss (P&L) statements.

Assist management with financial reviews, budgeting, and financial analysis.

Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies.

Collaborate with Finance and HR to maintain accurate payroll and financial records.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of hands‑on payroll processing experience .

Minimum 3 years of multistate payroll experience .

Proven ability to independently manage full-cycle payroll.

Hands‑on experience with general ledger accounting, journal entries, and account reconciliations .

This is an onsite opportunity in City of Industry, California, supporting payroll and accounting operations within the electrical and electronic manufacturing industry.

# Accounts Payable and Payroll Specialist

PrideStaff East Sacramento

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6661626941289178610?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=522&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3982934182902241915&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Accounts Payable / Payroll Specialist**

**PrideStaff Financial is working with a premiere manufacturing company in Sacramento who is seeking an Accounts Payable & Payroll Specialist.  The Accounts Payable & Payroll Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant execution of all payroll and accounts payable functions. The ideal Accounts Payable & Payroll Specialist will have previous experience working in HRIS and ERP systems along with Excel formulas including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUPS.   The Accounts Payable & Payroll Specialist position reports directly to the Accounting Manager.**

**Accounts Payable & Payroll Specialist Duties & Responsibilities:**

- **Process Multi-State Weekly/Bi-Weekly Payroll For Hourly, Salaried, & Contracted Staff**
- **Validate Timekeeping Data, Including Hours Worked, Overtime, PTO, & Wage Adjustments**
- **Maintain Employee Records Ensuring Full Compliance With Federal, State, & Local Regulations**
- **Manage Payroll lifecycle Changes, Covering New Hires, Terminations, Compensation Adjustments, & Benefits**
- **Reconcile Payroll Reports, For Month/Quarter/Year-End Closing, W-2 Prep, & Internal Audits**
- **Resolve Employee Payroll Inquiries With Timely & Professional Support**
- **Code & Process Vendor Invoices in Compliance With Company Policies**
- **3-Way Invoice Matching.  Purchase Orders, Receipts, & Invoices**
- **Manage Weekly Payment Runs Via Check, ACH, & Wire Transfers**
- **Maintain Vendor Records & Secure Required W-9 Documentation**
- **Reconcile Accounts Payables to the General Ledger**
- **Assist With Closing Activities, Including AP Accruals & Reporting**
- **Assist With Additional Business Needs as Requested**

SERVPRO® Team Carpenter

Now Hiring: Project Coordinator – Office Administration (Restoration Services)
Full-Time \| Office-Based \| Fast-Paced Restoration Company

Are you an experienced administrative professional who enjoys staying busy, keeping people organized, and making sure the details don't fall through the cracks?

SERVPRO Carmichael/Citrus Heights Roseville/E&W Modesto/Manteca is hiring a dependable, highly organized Project Coordinator to provide daily administrative support to our Project Managers and restoration teams.

This is a hands‑on office administration and operations position. We're looking for someone with strong administrative, customer service, scheduling, and follow‑up skills who can keep multiple active jobs organized and moving forward.

Experience in restoration, construction, insurance, property management, or a similar service-based business is a strong plus.

What You’ll Do
As a Project Coordinator, you'll help manage the day-to-day administrative details behind our restoration projects.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

Coordinate appointments, inspections, field crews, and job schedules.

Communicate with customers, insurance adjusters, vendors, and field personnel by phone, email, and text.

Maintain accurate and organized digital job files, including photos, notes, work authorizations, and project documents.

Enter and update job information in company software and project management systems.

Track job progress, outstanding paperwork, approvals, and deadlines.

Assist Project Managers with estimate documentation, job requirements, and customer updates.

Follow up on outstanding documents, authorizations, scheduling needs, and next steps.

Review job files for missing information and documentation accuracy.

Identify potential scheduling conflicts, delays, or administrative issues and communicate them promptly.

Support daily office operations and help ensure multiple active projects stay organized.

The Experience We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who has worked in a busy office environment where organization, communication, accuracy, and follow‑through are essential.

**Relevant experience includes:**

Administrative Assistant or Office Coordinator

Service Coordinator or Scheduling Coordinator

Construction or Restoration Office Administrator

Insurance Claims Assistant or Administrative Support

Property Management Coordinator

Dispatcher or Field Service Coordinator

Project Administrative Assistant

Experience in restoration, construction, HVAC, plumbing, insurance, property management, or other field service businesses is especially valuable.

Experience with job-management software, CRM platforms, DASH, Xactimate, or similar systems is a plus, but not required.

What We’re Looking For
**The right candidate is:**

Reliable, punctual, and accountable.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

Comfortable managing multiple active jobs and shifting priorities.

Confident speaking with customers and vendors on the phone.

Proactive about following up and completing outstanding tasks.

Our Hiring Process

We believe it's important for you to know where you stand in our hiring process. Below is an outline of the steps we take to make the best hires possible.

Our Talent Team and our partner – Total Quality Consulting (TQC Team) will review your submitted information and will call or email successful applicants for an interview as soon as possible.

In-Person Interview: After a screening call with TQC, we'll invite a final number of candidates to our office for an in-person interview or set up a live Zoom meeting with the hiring manager(s).

If we believe that you have what it takes, we'll make an offer and provide next steps in the hiring process!

About this Role

At Pacific Service Credit Union, we are committed to strategic growth through trust, innovation, and operational excellence. By empowering our internal teams with the tools and support they need to succeed, we strengthen organizational efficiency, ensure compliance, and advance our mission of enhancing member financial well-being.

The People Operations Coordinator is responsible for administrative and logistical support for employee training, learning programs, and other People Operations initiatives. This position coordinates training activities, maintains the Learning Management System (LMS), prepares program materials, tracks employee participation and completion, and facilitates assigned training sessions. The Coordinator also serves as a backup for the reception/front desk, helping create a welcoming and professional experience for employees, visitors, and business partners.

The People Operations Coordinator consistently embodies the credit union's and department's core values and mission while proactively stepping in to meet organizational needs.
The role requires an organized and dependable individual with strong communication skills and the ability to complete tasks accurately and on time. The position supports the team and organization by assisting with day-to-day activities, completing assigned projects, and contributing to efforts that advance organizational goals and uphold core values, while enhancing member/service outcomes.

Essential Job Functions

Training Coordination and Logistics

Coordinate logistics for in-person, virtual, and hybrid training programs, including scheduling, room reservations, invitations, technology, supplies, refreshments, and vendor arrangements.

Maintain the organization's training calendar and communicate program details, reminders, and changes to participants and leaders.

Prepare training rooms and confirm that equipment, technology, and materials are ready before each session.

Support facilitators and participants before, during, and after training programs.

Assist with training evaluations and compile participant feedback to support continuous improvement.

Learning Management System Administration

Manage day-to-day LMS administration, including course assignments, enrollments, user records, learning paths, completion records, and reporting.

Upload and maintain accurate course content, descriptions, materials, due dates, and attendance information.

Troubleshoot basic LMS access and functionality issues and coordinate with internal or external technical support as needed.

Maintain accurate electronic training records in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

Training Materials and Participant Tracking

Create, format, reproduce, organize, and distribute training materials, including presentations, participant guides, handouts, job aids, and evaluation forms.

Maintain inventories of training materials and supplies.

Track registration, attendance, participation, completion, evaluations, and certifications.

Prepare regular and ad hoc reports on training participation, completion rates, compliance, and other learning metrics.

Protect the confidentiality and accuracy of employee training records.

Training Delivery

Support Learning & Development team members in conducting training and other activities.

Provide clear instructions and create an engaging, inclusive learning environment.

Partner with subject-matter experts to coordinate or support department-specific training.

Assist with updating training content to ensure information remains accurate and relevant.

Reception and Front Desk Backup

Provide reception/front desk coverage during breaks, absences, meetings, and other designated times.

Greet employees, visitors, vendors, and applicants in a professional and welcoming manner.

Assist with visitor check-in, mail and package handling, and other basic reception responsibilities.

Follow established safety, security, and confidentiality procedures.

General People Operations Support

Provide administrative support for People Operations programs, meetings, events, and special projects.

Serves as backup to take highlight minutes and document tasks during weekly team meetings if HR Assistant is unavailable.

Contribute to company innovation and continuous improvement. Foster a culture of evolution by adapting to changes, optimizing processes, and contributing to the growth and success of the organization.

Demonstrate accountability in your work by taking ownership of responsibilities, setting clear goals, meeting deadlines, and delivering high-quality results. Act with integrity, follow through on commitments, and uphold professional standards.

Support and uphold company culture by aligning your work with the credit union's mission and values, contributing to a positive, high-performing environment.

Demonstrate dependable performance including attendance and punctuality, recognizing that it is essential to organizational excellence and operational success.

Comply with all anti-money laundering laws, including the Bank Secrecy Act, OFAC regulations, and the USA PATRIOT Act, as well as all related policies and procedures.

Supporting Functions

Provide back-up and support to management, as directed.

Performs special projects and other responsibilities, as directed.

The following competencies are essential for success in this role:

Job knowledge: Demonstrates solid job expertise; learns and applies new skills effectively; works with minimal supervision; understands how work impacts others; uses resources efficiently.

##### Hotel Operations Manager

Rancho Cordova Homewood Suites by Hilton

Salary: $72,000-$75,000 based on experience

Are you ready to advance your career to the next level? Are you a passionate hospitality professional? How about hands on, energetic, and driven? Tharaldson wants you!

We provide a friendly, professional place to work and have fun, with opportunities for advancement and career growth. A strong company culture inspires staff to achieve the highest service standards in hospitality. Tharaldson has 90 hotels nationwide and will be adding to our hotel portfolio in the next 3 years, providing growth opportunities for our team members!

WHAT WE OFFER:

- Career advancement opportunities
- Employee discounts
- Competitive pay
- Daily Pay Option
- Flexible work schedule
- Comprehensive benefits for you and your family including (medical, vision, dental, 401k, Profit Sharing)
- Paid Vacation

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

- Monitors and ensures compliance with all guidelines for operations
- Conducts monthly department meetings to review new procedures and solicit input from all employees
- Handles and provides resolution to guest complaints and employee issues
- Assigns duties to employees and subordinates and observes performance to ensure adherence to hotel and franchise policies and established operating procedures
- Answers inquiries pertaining to hotel policies and services
- Assists General Manager in annual wage scale surveys; ensures employee wages follow wage and salary guidelines
- Ensures property hiring practices comply with all state and federal requirements
- Performs functions of the General Manager in their absence
- Supervises work activities of housekeeping staff
- Provides training, including safety training and standard operating procedures to all housekeeping personnel as directed by management
- Ensures adherence to company quality standards by inspecting rooms, including deep cleans
- Distributes keys and work assignments to staff
- Addresses guest complaints regarding housekeeping service or equipment
- Assists General Manager in the selection of housekeeping personnel
- Assists management staff of hotel in assuring housekeeping staff is practicing efficient and effective procedures
- Monitors linen and guest supply inventory
- Reports any maintenance repairs to maintenance staff; records repair information in maintenance log
- Completes follow-up on vacant or occupied rooms
- Assumes function of Housekeeper as necessary
- Takes control of lost and found items as appropriate
- All other duties as assigned

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Directly supervises front desk, housekeeping, laundry, and/or maintenance staff as determined by General Manager. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- Preferably 1+ year of similar experience in Select Service or Extended Stay properties
- Brand Experience preferred.
- Knowledgeable in Inventories, Scheduling, and Ordering.
- Valid Driver's License.
- Open Availability.
- Education Preferred of Associates degree or equivalent from two-year college, or technical school; or six months to one-year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

# Field Operations Manager

AIO App Inc

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-484636492270650824?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8101628839577041818&crId=US_0US_0)

Position Title: Field Operations Manager

Location: Bay Area, CA (Onsite / Field)

**About the Role:**

As Field Operations Manager, you will own the physical side of how AIO reaches customers — from the moment hardware arrives at our warehouse through to installation, training, and ongoing in‑person support at customer locations. This is a hands‑on, Bay Area‑based role with national shipping responsibility and direct customer contact.

You will lead a small field team, manage our hardware inventory end‑to‑end, and be the person customers and internal teams rely on when something physical needs to get done right.

What will your responsibilities be?
Customer Deployment, Installation & Training

Lead the prep and configuration of hardware for all new customer deployments — from inventory to customer‑ready

Own Bay Area installations end‑to‑end: coordinate scheduling, lead or supervise on‑site installs, and ensure every go‑live meets AIO's standards

Deliver hands‑on customer training at installation, ensuring restaurant staff are confident using the system from day one

Own installation SLAs — track team efficiency, identify bottlenecks, and hold the process to a consistent, high bar

Coordinate outbound hardware shipments to customers outside the Bay Area, ensuring accurate packing, labeling, and timely dispatch

On‑Ground Customer Support

Manage the team delivering in‑person technical support to Bay Area customers who are hard down, at churn risk, or require hands‑on resolution

Build and maintain support playbooks that enable the team to resolve common issues quickly and consistently

Be willing to be in the field personally when the situation demands it — this is a working manager role

Hardware Inventory Ownership

Own all physical inventory: receiving, organizing, and maintaining accurate stock at the warehouse

Lead weekly cycle counts and monthly physical inventory audits; resolve discrepancies promptly

Ensure all hardware movement — inbound and outbound — is logged correctly so system records stay accurate

Maintain storage protocols and ensure devices are properly staged, labeled, and ready for deployment

Team Leadership

Directly manage the local field team — setting clear expectations, running structured check‑ins, and developing each person's capabilities

Build a culture of accountability where SLAs, accuracy, and customer outcomes are non‑negotiable

Coordinate with Pakistan‑based operations colleagues on system records and workflow handoffs

Monitor team capacity on an ongoing basis — tracking workload against pipeline, flagging when headcount is stretched, and partnering with the COO to get ahead of hiring needs before they become gaps

What are we looking for and what does it require to be the right fit for this role?

5+ years in field operations, implementation, logistics, or a hands‑on customer‑facing operations role.

Experience managing a small team in a fast‑moving environment.

Comfortable with hardware — unboxing, configuring, troubleshooting, and shipping technology equipment.

Organized and detail‑oriented when it comes to inventory — you notice when something is off and you fix it.

Natural with customers: able to build trust quickly, communicate clearly, and represent AIO well in someone's place of business.

Valid driver's license and reliable access to transport for Bay Area site visits.

Restaurant industry, hospitality tech, or POS experience is a meaningful plus.

Why Join AIO?
Our mission is to revolutionize the US restaurant industry by providing a comprehensive and fully integrated solution that empowers restaurant owners to efficiently manage all aspects of their business. Our platform combines our patented AI technology with unparalleled customer support to help owners increase revenue, reduce costs, and improve their overall profit margins.

We believe that restaurants should be able to focus on delivering exceptional dining experiences to their customers, without the added stress of managing complex and disparate systems. That's why we offer an All‑In‑One super app platform for all their needs, from front‑of‑the‑house operations like ordering, payment, marketing and rewards, to back‑of‑the‑house management like inventory, staff, and financials.

We are laser focused on becoming a significant player in the 55 billion restaurant tech SaaS market. You will be a part of a world class, up‑and‑coming Silicon Valley funded startup.

# Dispatcher

FirstLine Road Solutions

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

We are looking for a quality Dispatcher to work 11am to 7:30pm Monday thru Friday to join our growing team. An ideal Dispatcher is someone who likes multi-tasking, is a creative problem solver, communicates well in a team environment, and has excellent customer service skills in person and over the phone. This role is critical to the success of the company and the right candidate must be reliable.

Tow Truck Operators keep our highways safe and are classified as First Responders. Come join the team and be an important part of your community!

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include:**

- Ensure exceptional customer service
- Answer incoming calls from customers
- Using dispatch software to dispatch trucks to customers
- Documenting conversations
- Helping drivers troubleshoot problems
- Assessing the safety of roadside situations
- Dispatch software expert ensuring all call information, notes, pricing, and customer information is entered and correct
- Ensuring customers and drivers receive timely and accurate dispatch help
- Helping drivers trouble shoot issues
- All other duties as assigned by Supervisor

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

- There are no supervisory responsibilities for this role.

Requirements

- 1 Year experience in customer service preferred
- 1 year experience with dispatching preferred
- Extremely organized and detailed oriented
- High school diploma or equivalent
- Dispatch Software experience preferred
- Must reside near assigned area

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to use hands to fingers, reach, climb stairs, walk, sit for long periods of time, talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Offers of employment are contingent upon the results of successfully passing a background screening including a criminal background check, a review of motor vehicle records, social security screening, and a drug and alcohol test as required by law.

# Dispatcher

Quinn

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7996318971162635155?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5245809509696726642&crId=US_0US_0)

Overview
Administer the Company’s transportation functions within a defined geographic region. Dispatch transportation assets to ensure efficient and responsive customer service. Comply with company, state, and federal DOT guidelines.

Wages
Starting wage will depend on experience and education. $25.80-$26.00

Responsibilities
Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Ensure prompt and accurate delivery/pick-up of all assigned equipment moves for Quinn Group business units.

Manage and coordinate equipment movement through the use of applicable transportation and rental software.

Plan, assign and direct workflow.

Communicate with customers / employees to research and resolve transportation problems/issues.

Manage and control outside equipment hauling frequency and employee overtime expenses.

Allocate transportation expenses to appropriate departments.

Ensure drivers comply with 90 day Biennial Inspection of Terminals requirements (BIT inspections).

Verify drivers’ daily submission of log books and vehicle inspection reports.

Ensure drivers adhere to regularly scheduled delivery vehicle maintenance intervals and meet Company and DOT standards / regulations.

Collect inspection documents from drivers and submit to appropriate departments.

Maintain and promote a safe work environment. Ensure any employee accidents / injuries are reported and documented promptly.

Demonstrate and promote Quinn Company core values of Integrity, Teamwork, Respect, Quality and Service. Create an environment that inspires a commitment to excellence, self & company respect, loyalty and trust.

Align, partner, and collaborate with assigned HR representative to proactively manage employee relations and support / develop business unit objectives.

Visit each branch within assigned region a minimum of three times a year.

Qualifications
High School / GED and two - three years of related industry experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Sunny Distributor Inc

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2719963409378212973?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=530684171497578615&crId=US_0US_0)

We are looking for a highly experienced Marketing Manager to be in charge of the organization’s marketing ventures. This primarily involves developing and implementing strategies to strengthen the company’s market presence and help it find a “voice” that will make a difference.
Job Description: Development and implementation of the Brand strategy.
Developing the marketing strategy for new and existing products
Overseeing implementation of the Marketing strategies, including campaigns, events, digital marketing, and PR.
Direct, manage and coach the marketing team to establish plans, set priorities, execute to achieve marketing objectives, and ensure team members grow professionally.
Working closely with the company’s Sales and Product Development teams; enabling them to meet their commercial objectives by providing them with appropriate tools, materials and presentations
Ensuring that the marketing objectives are implemented by the marketing team.
Work closely with creative and production team to define marketing materials and programs.
Highly experienced in Content Production and Editing to guide team.
Manage social media presence and direct programs to improve social media reputation and recognition.
Developing and delivering marketing and communications strategies for the organization.
Undertake continuous analysis of competitive environment and consumer trends
Control budgets and allocate resources among projects.
Establish clear testing strategies and success metrics (traffic, subscribers, etc) for programs, regularly report progress, and explain how results will inform future direction
Conduct general market research to keep abreast of trends and competitor’s marketing movements
Requirements: Bachelors or master’s degree in Marketing
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Marketing
Proven track record of success in senior digital marketing roles.
Experienced with online programs (SEM/SEO, CSE, Paid Social, Display, Affiliate, Marketplace)
Up to speed with current and online marketing techniques and best practices
Thorough knowledge of web analytics (e.g. Google Analytics, WebTrends etc.) and Google AdWords
Previous experience in B2B and/or B2C retail environment
Previous experience in digital marketing; traffic acquisition, affiliates, emails, data analytics, creative, social, mobile, video and more.
Previous experience in managing, growing, and mentoring a medium-sized team, including Marketing and Creative personnel.

# Recruiting Operations Manager

$120k - $150k

Hex Technologies Inc

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2316487865057754084?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7408546284928081615&crId=US_0US_0)

About the role: As Recruiting Operations Manager , you'll own the systems, processes, data, and programs that power hiring at Hex. This is a builder role.
You'll take a recruiting function that'S growing fast and give it infrastructure that scales: clean data, sharp reporting, efficient workflows, and a hiring experience we're proud of. The goal isn't a process that merely holds up under load. It's a hiring system that gets measurably better every quarter, where automation handles the mechanical work so recruiters and hiring managers spend their time on judgment, relationships, and closing.
You'll be the person who turns "we should really fix this" into a durable, adopted process. You'll report to the Head of Talent and work cross-functionally with Finance, People Operations, and Data.
What you'll do: Architect the system
Own the recruiting tech stack end to end: ATS, sourcing, scheduling, and assessment tools, including configuration, integrations, and vendor management.
Design and continuously improve the hiring workflow from req approval and intake through sourcing, coordination, offer, and close, removing or automating manual steps wherever possible.
Make the build-versus-buy calls, and the consolidate-versus-keep calls. Decide what earns a place in the stack.
Own the data
Build recruiting analytics leadership actually uses to make decisions: pipeline health, funnel conversion, time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and hiring forecasts.
Establish and enforce data hygiene and reporting standards so the numbers can be trusted, including the unglamorous work of making sure signal gets captured on candidates we pass on, not just the ones we hire.
Partner with Finance and People on headcount planning, req management, and the operational link between the hiring plan and what's actually in the pipeline.
Ship AI and automation with architecture behind it
Identify where AI genuinely improves the funnel, build it into the workflow deliberately, and define how we'll know whether it worked.
Set the guardrails and build the shared, reusable set of workflows the whole team runs on, so we're not accumulating a dozen private experiments with no measurable lift.
Be clear and opinionated about where a human stays in the loop.
Run experiments
Treat hiring as a system with defined inputs and outputs. Test sourcing approaches, interview structures, and automations, and measure whether they improve quality and not just speed.
Lead interviewer training, structured interview rollout, and consistency programs that raise the bar and reduce bias.
Build the operating rhythm: dashboards, weekly reporting, QBR inputs, and real adoption of the processes you create.
Protect the candidate experience
Own candidate experience operationally: scheduling SLAs, communication cadences, and feedback loops, so every candidate gets a smooth, high-signal process.
Make sure the automation underneath still reads as human. Candidates should never be able to tell where the system ends and we begin. They should just notice that we were fast, clear, and prepared.
What we're looking for: 6+ years in recruiting operations, talent operations, or a closely related People Ops, BizOps, or analytics role, including experience scaling a function at a high-growth company.
Deep hands-on expertise with an ATS (ideally Ashby) as an admin and workflow builder, not just a user.
Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable owning recruiting data, building dashboards, and turning funnel metrics into clear recommendations. Comfort with SQL and BI tools is a real plus.
Evidence you build things. Internal tools, automations, prompt libraries, or workflow experiments you shipped because you saw the problem, not because someone assigned it.
A track record of turning messy, manual processes into scalable, documented, adopted workflows. Adoption is the hard part and we'll ask about it.
Experience implementing AI-powered recruiting automation, and a clear point of view on where it helps and where it shouldn't go.
Sound judgment on when to automate, when to redesign the process, and when to keep it simple.
Experience partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, People, and Data, including non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action. This role shapes its own playbook as the function grows.
Bonus: headcount planning tools, HRIS systems, and experience working alongside a data team.
In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.
The salary range for this role is: $120,000 - $150,000
The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.

Lone Wolf empowers real estate customers to succeed and grow. As we deepen relationships with our highest-value accounts, we're seeking a strategic Account Based Marketing function to turn account insight into targeted, revenue-driving campaigns—and we need a leader to own it.
We're looking for a strategic, self-directed marketer who designs and executes targeted, data-driven campaigns for our highest-value accounts. You'll work in close alignment with sales teams, but you own the strategy.
This means evaluating and prioritizing accounts with sales, determining what success looks like, and building the measurement framework to track it. You'll collaborate closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Marketing Operations, while leading the strategic direction of account-based marketing initiatives.
Responsibilities: Account-Based Marketing Strategy Partner with Sales to evaluate target accounts and develop account selection criteria.

Define the strategic rationale for account prioritization and segmentation.

Determine which accounts represent the greatest opportunity and why.

Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to target account segments.

Use account, market, and performance data to continuously refine targeting strategies.

Deliver account recommendations and insights that help Sales improve account prioritization over time.

Account-Based Campaign Development & Execution Design and execute multi-channel ABM programs, including:
Email marketing

Digital advertising

Direct mail campaigns

Events and webinars

Content marketing initiatives

Create account-specific messaging and campaign strategies.

Partner with Content, Design, and Marketing Operations teams to bring campaigns to life.

Ensure campaigns align to revenue goals and account engagement objectives.

Sales Partnership & Strategic Planning Collaborate with Sales teams to understand account priorities and opportunities.

Evaluate whether ABM is the most effective approach for target accounts.

Challenge assumptions and validate account strategies using market intelligence and data.

Provide strategic guidance on account engagement and expansion opportunities.

Act as a trusted advisor to Sales while maintaining an objective, data-driven perspective.

Measurement & Performance Strategy Define campaign success metrics and measurement frameworks.

Partner with Marketing Operations to establish reporting for:
Campaign performance

Account engagement

Pipeline influence

Revenue impact

Analyze results and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

Use performance data to optimize future campaign strategy and investment decisions.

Personalization & Optimization Leverage account, customer, and intent data to build personalized experiences.

Segment audiences to improve campaign relevance and effectiveness.

Monitor campaign outcomes and identify drivers of success or underperformance.

Continuously test, learn, and optimize campaign approaches based on performance insights.

Account Advocacy Serve as the voice of target accounts within the marketing organization.

Share market and account insights with Product Marketing, Sales, and leadership.

Help influence broader marketing, messaging, and product strategies based on customer needs and feedback.

Requirements: 5-7 years of B2B marketing experience.

Proven experience building, managing, and optimizing:
Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs

Field marketing initiatives

Revenue-focused campaign strategies

Experience partnering directly with Sales organizations on strategic account planning.

Demonstrated ability to make data-driven marketing decisions and influence business outcomes.

Strong strategic thinking and ability to operate independently.

Experience developing multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to:
Interpret performance data

Identify trends and opportunities

Make strategic recommendations

Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

Preferred Experience in:
B2B SaaS organizations

Real estate technology (PropTech)

Real estate-related industries

Experience with:
HubSpot

Salesforce

Marketing automation platforms

CRM systems

Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

Focuses on business outcomes, not just campaign execution.

Uses data to guide strategy development and optimization.

Asks thoughtful questions and translates insights into action.

Cross-Functional Partnership Builds strong relationships across Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Sales Enablement.

Influences stakeholders without direct authority.

Balances collaboration with strategic conviction.

Critical Thinking Takes a first-principles approach to problem solving.

Evaluates strategies based on account needs and business objectives rather than industry "best practices."

Maintains intellectual curiosity and adaptability in a changing market.

##### Catering Administrative Assistant

Steeped in rich history of tradition, The Olympic Club was founded in 1860. It is one of the nation's oldest private member athletic clubs, is comprised of the City Clubhouse in downtown San Francisco and the Lakeside Clubhouse on the border of San Francisco and Daly City.

The City Clubhouse is a spectacular historic building in downtown San Francisco offering eighteen hotel rooms, dining and banquet facilities, athletic courts, two pools, a fitness center, locker rooms, a retail shop and other amenities including massage, steam/sauna, shoeshine, and a barbershop.

Overlooking the beautiful Pacific Ocean, the Lakeside Clubhouse boasts two championship golf courses, the Lake and Ocean, and one executive course, the Cliffs. With its spectacular view of the golf courses, the Lakeside Clubhouse offers dining and banquet facilities, locker rooms, tennis courts and a fitness center with lap pool.

**Position Overview:**

Reporting to the Director of Catering & Events, this role is primarily responsible for supporting the Lakeside Catering department.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

- Answer phones and greet members.
- Schedule appointments and maintain calendars.
- Schedule and coordinate staff and other meetings
- Collate and distribute mail.
- Prepare communications, such as memos, emails, invoices, reports and other catering department correspondence.
- Create and maintain buffet tags for weekly events.
- Create menus required for weekly events.
- Take and confirm dining and special event reservations and provide information to others about these events. Make confirmation calls to members regarding event reservations.
- Attend weekly BEO meetings and create a weekly synopsis of the meeting and distribute to departments throughout the club.
- Will be a key user of Whoosh software and overall Lakeside Clubhouse event schedule
- Maintains effective relationships with members and is able to provide reservations throughout the club.
- Assists the Director of Catering & Events with event billing.
- Orders office supplies for the catering department.
- Assists the Catering Coordinator with any additional printing needs for the catering department.
- Acts as a key administrative teammate to all staff members and is open and transparent in all communications.
- Must be able to work some evenings and weekends based on operational needs
- Takes and forwards any inquiries to the right departments when needed.
- Complies with all federal, state and local employment laws, safety regulations and guidelines, Olympic Club bylaws and house rules, Club policies and procedures and Union contracts

\\* Regular attendance required based on business expectations and needs.

\\* Complies with all federal, state, and local employment laws, safety regulations and guidelines, Olympic Club bylaws and house rules, Club policies and procedures and Union contracts.

**Non-essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

- Attend Management meetings and other meetings as requested by the Senior Director of Clubhouses

**Qualifications Required:**

• Strong oral and written English communication skills

• Use of computer basic computer programs such as Word, Excel, MS Office Suite & Catering Software

##### Executive Assistant

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block's Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We're building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We're an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner's Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

##### About the Role

We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Executive Assistant to support several leaders on the executive team. This is a fast-paced, high-impact role where you'll manage complex calendars, coordinate travel, plan events, act as a liaison for internal teams, and provide personal assistance as needed.

We need a sharp, dependable partner who can anticipate needs, maintain alignment on what matters most, and ensure information flows seamlessly across the organization.

##### In This Role, You Will

- Manage complex calendars, prioritize meetings across competing requests, and keep schedules running smoothly
- Handle travel and event logistics end-to-end, including last-minute changes and plans
- Act as a central point of contact, keeping communication moving and organized
- Support preparation for meetings, take notes, and track follow-ups and action items
- Support personal logistics and requests
- Help support team culture through onboarding, events, and day-to-day coordination
- Track and manage team budgets and financial reporting

##### Your Background Looks Something Like This

- Have 2+ years of Executive Assistant experience supporting C-level leaders or founders (ideally in a fast paced start-up environment)
- Excel at managing complex calendars, travel, and competing priorities with precision
- Are proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented, always thinking two steps ahead
- Communicate effectively, concise when needed, detailed when necessary
- Thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where flexibility is essential
- Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism
- Anticipating needs before they arise
- Has a "no job is too small" attitude and takes on challenges with enthusiasm

##### Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

- Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
- Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
- Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
- Parental Leave
- Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
- Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance
- Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
- Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon's policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

Job Function Summary:

Under direct supervision of the Otolaryngology – (OHNS) Practice Supervisor, the Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator will work independently and have responsibility for providing administrative support to the Facial Plastic OHNS practice. The the Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator functions as primary contact for tertiary new and returning patients requiring ambulatory care at UCSF Health Facial Plastics. S/he will work closely with the administrative and management teams to support practice operations, complex surgery scheduling, billing and work queue knowledge and advanced care coordination with multiple departments at UCSF. The Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator serves as a liaison to management to advise on, take lead action on, and provide direction on process improvements initiatives. S/he provides support to all functions of the administrative teams including oversight of: registering and scheduling patients, checking in and out patients, referral work queue management, authorizations, insurance verification, surgery depot management, OR block time utilization, APeX in baskets, scanning and filing. As an Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator, s/he is responsible for addressing and resolving escalated issues of day to day operations in addition to maintaining daily administrative operations and communications relations to the clinic staff, to social workers, physicians and multiple department staff when coordinating advanced care. As a subject-matter expert in patient scheduling and the electronic medical record, the Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator will assist in template building, adjustments, scheduling improvements, and work with support staff and the clinical team to ensure seamless day-to-day clinic operations. The Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator will participate in performance improvement initiative such as the True North Board, in pulling data for the clinic and in feedback related to staff performance. The Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator will participate in UCSF’s Ambulatory-wide initiatives to represent the department and may also present at monthly staff meetings and division meetings with any updates.

S/he works as a team member with other practice staff and consistently projects a professional and courteous demeanor. S/he is a team player who works closely with others and who is flexible in dealing with the changing priorities. S/he is a self-reliant individual who synthesizes his/her knowledge of practice operations in order to problem-solve, prioritize and facilitate complex transactions in the course of his/her daily activities. In addition to providing the day-to-day practice support, the Ambulatory Administrative Coordinator will assist in staff orientation and ongoing training; redistributes work within the OHNS Facial Plastics team as needed; covers for OHNS staff when they are out; helps to supervise and cover other areas of the practice when the Director or supervisor are off-site.

S/he must have the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks and work well with staff, patients and providers. A high degree of independence, initiative, assertiveness, and diplomacy are necessary in dealing with faculty, staff and patients in a complex environment. This position functions in the outpatient clinical settings at all UCSF Health sites (Parnassus, Mt. Zion, joint UCSF health partnerships, Satellite Clinics, or with UCSF Faculty at other off-site clinic sites, et al).

Specialty programs include Otology and Neurotology, Head and Neck Surgery, Rhinology and Endoscopic Sinus Surgery, Endocrine (Thyroid and Parathyroid) Surgery, Skull Base Surgery, Facial Plastic surgery,

### Job Description

Job Description

We are seeking a highly organized, personable, and proactive Healthcare Administrative Coordinator / Patient Services Representative to join a busy onsite healthcare team. This position plays an important role in creating a positive patient experience while supporting the day-to-day administrative needs of multiple healthcare service lines.

This is an onsite, temp-to-hire opportunity for a candidate who demonstrates a strong fit with the workflow, team environment, and client culture. All patients served at the facility are employees of the client organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Check patients in and out while providing a welcoming, professional experience.

- Schedule appointments and manage waitlists across multiple healthcare service lines.

- Answer and respond to calls forwarded by the call center.

- Review scheduling requests and ensure patients are booked for the appropriate appointment and service type.

- Ensure required paperwork, consent forms, and other documentation are completed prior to patient visits.

- Respond to patient messages in a timely, courteous, and professional manner.

- Coordinate communication between different healthcare service lines to support continuity of care and an efficient patient experience.

- Fax documentation and correspondence to patients, healthcare facilities, and other appropriate parties.

- Order, organize, and maintain office supplies.

- Work collaboratively with the second onsite administrator, Medical Assistants, clinicians, and other members of the healthcare team.

- Identify workflow or patient-service issues and proactively work toward solutions.

- Perform additional administrative and operational duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**

- Previous healthcare administrative, medical office, patient services, or similar experience strongly preferred.

- Experience working directly with patients and delivering a high level of customer/patient service is a strong plus.

- Familiarity with Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, particularly Epic, is preferred.

- Strong scheduling, organizational, and multitasking abilities.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with patients, clinicians, and administrative team members.

- Ability to manage competing priorities in a busy, multi-service healthcare environment.

- Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to recognize needs without always waiting for direction.

- Comfortable working as part of a sizeable, collaborative onsite team.

- Professional, courteous, dependable, and patient-focused.


**Work Environment**

This position is 100% onsite at the client facility and supports several healthcare service lines available to client employees, including:

- Primary Care

- Chiropractic Care

- Physical Therapy

- Therapy/Behavioral Health Services

- Acupuncture

- Additional onsite health and wellness services


The successful candidate will work closely with another onsite administrative team member as well as Medical Assistants and healthcare providers across the various service lines.

Temp-to-Hire Opportunity

This position is intended to be temp-to-hire. Candidates who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, proactive problem-solving, excellent patient service, and alignment with the team's workflow and company/client culture may be considered for long-term employment.

##### Legal Administrative Assistant

A highly respected, established investment management firm is seeking an experienced Legal Administrative Assistant to join its collaborative Legal team in San Francisco. This is an outstanding opportunity for a polished, highly organized administrative professional who enjoys working with senior leadership and wants to build a long-term career within a sophisticated, team-oriented organization. Supporting the General Counsel and broader Legal team, this individual will play an integral role in keeping the department organized, responsive, and operating efficiently. The firm offers an exceptional culture centered around collaboration, intellectual curiosity, continuous learning, and work/life balance, along with some of the strongest benefits in the market.

What You'll Do

- Provide calendar and administrative support to the General Counsel and members of the Legal team
- Coordinate contracts and documents submitted to Legal for review and help manage department workflows
- Serve as a key internal liaison for employees working with the Legal department
- Manage meetings from start to finish, including scheduling, agendas, materials, conference rooms, technology, catering, and guest coordination
- Coordinate domestic and international travel, conference registrations, itineraries, and expense reporting
- Prepare, edit, format, and proofread correspondence, presentations, memoranda, minutes, contracts, procedures, and corporate records
- Maintain corporate records, minute books, powers of attorney, apostilles, and other legal documentation
- Notarize documents and coordinate filings and service requests
- Assist with department events, team activities, and special projects
- Partner closely with administrative professionals across Legal, Compliance, and Risk and provide coverage as needed
- Help the team adopt new technology, software, and AI-enabled tools that improve efficiency

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, service-minded, and exceptionally organized, with the judgment and discretion required to work with confidential information and senior professionals. You'll bring:

- 5+ years of relevant administrative experience; financial services or legal environment strongly preferred
- Experience supporting senior-level professionals on a legal team and managing complex calendars, meetings, travel, and expenses
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong proofreading and document-production skills
- High proficiency with Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint, and Adobe Acrobat
- Comfort learning new technologies and an interest in using AI tools to improve processes
- A calm, flexible approach and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Strong judgment, professionalism, and discretion
- Bachelor's degree preferred
- Current Notary license or willingness to become a Notary

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

- This firm is known for its stability, collaborative culture, exceptional benefits, and commitment to its employees. Highlights include:
- $100K–$120K base salary + discretionary bonus
- 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for employees and their families
- Firm-funded retirement contribution
- Strong emphasis on work/life balance
- Collaborative team of experienced administrative professionals
- Commuter and health club benefits
- Hybrid flexibility

Please submit your resume for consideration! We will consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. California applicants, please view our Privacy Notice here.

The Executive Assistant to the General Manager is a highly organized, proactive, and trustworthy individual who will provide administrative and operational support. This role is ideal for someone who is resourceful, discreet, detail oriented, and comfortable managing a wide range of priorities with minimal supervision. The successful candidate will anticipate needs, stay ahead of deadlines, coordinate multiple moving pieces, and bring a calm, solutions-oriented approach to every situation.

Manage a complex calendar, including scheduling, prioritization, and coordination of internal and external meetings.
Proactively identify scheduling conflicts and recommend solutions.
Prepare meetings by organizing agendas, background materials, presentations, and other relevant information.
Manage meeting logistics, including conference rooms, virtual meetings, catering, and other arrangements.
Monitor and follow up on action items and commitments resulting from meetings.
Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion.

Communication & Coordination
Draft, edit, and proofread correspondence, presentations, reports, meeting notes and other communications.
Manage incoming requests and communications, determining appropriate priorities and follow-up.
Ensure important information and deadlines are communicated and tracked effectively.
Track key projects, deadlines, and follow-up items to ensure timely completion.
Conduct research, compile information, and prepare summaries or recommendations.
Maintain organized documents and ensure all relevant items are uploaded to the company SharePoint.
Support the GM in maintaining visibility into key priorities and upcoming commitments.

Travel Logistics & Operational Support
Organize domestic and international business travel, including flights, hotels, transportation, itineraries, and changes.
Assist with planning and logistics for special events.
Process and track expenses, invoices, and reimbursements.
Facilitate the resolution of issues related to laptops, monitors, phones, and other hardware.

Profile
3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Executive Assistant, or similar role supporting a senior executive.
Experience supporting C-suite executives or senior leadership is strongly preferred.
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively under pressure.
Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
Highly proactive and able to anticipate needs.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Experience with calendar management, virtual meeting platforms, expense systems, and other business productivity tools.
Professional presence and the ability to interact confidently with executives and external stakeholders.

# Lead Executive Assistant

$125k - $140k

OpenGov, Inc.

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6869206758511835960?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4258840282257849991&crId=US_0US_0)

## Executive Assistant

We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to provide strategic and operational support to the Chief Administrative Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and General Counsel. This role is central to driving operational excellence, fostering company culture, and enabling strategic decision-making across OpenGov's executive leadership team.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive, culturally-attuned partner who excels at managing complex executive priorities while serving as a cultural bridge across the organization. You'll coordinate high-impact events, offsites, and initiatives that strengthen OpenGov's culture and engagement, while simultaneously managing the sophisticated logistics of supporting three senior executives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants to amplify impact beyond traditional admin work. You'll be instrumental in shaping how leadership connects with the organization, how key decisions get made, and how our people experience OpenGov's values.

## Core Responsibilities

Executive Support & Strategic Partnership

- Multi-Executive Calendar & Inbox Management: Proactively manage complex calendars for the CAO, CFO, and GC across multiple time zones and business priorities. Anticipate scheduling conflicts, suggest trade-offs, and block time strategically to protect focus on highest-impact work.
- Executive Coordination & Alignment: Serve as a key connective node between the three executives and across organizational departments. Facilitate seamless communication, flag misalignments early, and help drive execution on shared priorities.
- Meeting Preparation & Documentation: Develop comprehensive briefing materials, agendas and presentations for team meetings. Take detailed notes during key discussions, clearly document action items with owners and deadlines, and ensure follow-through on commitments.
- Travel Management: Plan domestic and international travel itineraries for executives and leadership team. Handle logistics including accommodations, ground transportation, visa coordination, and real-time adjustments. Leverage AI tools to optimize travel planning and expense reporting.
- Process Optimization & Documentation: Identify opportunities to streamline recurring processes (meeting cadences, approvals, communications). Document processes and maintain operational playbooks that scale as the company grows.

Culture & Events Leadership

Culture Events & Execution: Help support company all hands meetings, happy hours and other internal events, working cross functionally with partners in Workplace and HR.

- Offsite Management: Lead the planning and execution of team offsites. This may include venue selection, agenda design and logistics coordination. Create experiences that foster strategic thinking, team building, and culture reinforcement.
- Cultural Listening & Insight: Maintain a pulse on team engagement and culture through informal connections across the organization. Bring observations and insights to leadership about what's resonating, what needs attention, and how to strengthen culture.

AI & Modern Tools Leadership

- AI Tool Adoption and Workflow Innovation: Actively explore and pilot AI-powered tools to enhance team productivity. Examples: scheduling automation, meeting transcription and summarization, email drafting assistance, presentation generation, and workflow optimization.
- Best Practices Sharing: Stay informed on emerging AI and automation trends and share insights with the broader admin team.

## Key Attributes & Competencies

Strategic Mindset

- Understands the business context behind decisions and initiatives
- Anticipates needs before they're asked for
- Thinks beyond the immediate task to broader impact

Cultural Intelligence & EQ

- High emotional intelligence with ability to build trust and read the room across all levels of the organization
- Balances professionalism with warmth; demonstrates OpenGov values in daily interactions

Operational Excellence

- Obsessive attention to detail while managing high complexity
- Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
- Strong time management and ability to juggle competing priorities

Communication & Influence

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to distill complex information into clear executive summaries
- Comfortable communicating with executives, boards, and employees

Judgment & Discretion

- Trustworthy with confidential and sensitive information
- Demonstrates good judgment about what needs escalation vs. what you can handle independently
- Maintains objectivity and professionalism in complex situations

Learning Agility & Curiosity

- Quick learner who becomes fluent in OpenGov's business, products, and culture
- Intellectually curious about how organizations work and how to make them work better
- Comfortable with technology and eager to learn new tools

## Requirements & Preferred Experience

Required:

- 5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, or similar role supporting C-suite executives
- Demonstrated experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously or leading a team
- Strong project management skills with experience coordinating executive priorities. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar), Microsoft Office, and productivity tools.
- Experience working with AI-powered automation tools to enhance efficiency.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft executive-level materials.
- 5 days a week in office.

## Preferred:

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- Experience in SaaS, Technology, or a high-growth startup environment.
- Familiarity with project management tools.
- Notary commission, or willingness to become a notary

Compensation: San Francisco, CA: $125,000 - $140,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate's geographical location.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Executive Assistant**

San Francisco, CA

At Rothy’s, we know there’s a better way to do business, and it starts by putting the planet and its people first. More than 225 million single-use plastic bottles and 715,000 pounds of ocean-bound marine plastic have been transformed into our signature thread, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

Striving for zero waste, we combine 3D knitting technology and handcrafted assembly to create machine washable styles that don’t compromise on comfort. From classic shoes to carry-everywhere bags, we create essentials for wherever you go.

At Rothy’s, building a sustainable future is at the heart of everything we do. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive environment at our HQ, retail stores and wholly-owned factory, and are growing our community every day.

**About the role:**

Rothy's is looking for an experienced and energetic Executive Assistant to support members of our Executive Team. In this role, you'll do more than keep things moving — you'll be a trusted thought partner, helping our executives communicate with clarity, show up prepared, and lead with impact. Do you think three steps ahead, have a positive/can-do attitude, and thrive on gracefully handling multiple demands in a fast-paced environment? Are you collaborative, kind, and curious? If this sounds like you, this might be the right fit!

**What you’ll do:**

- Serve as a strategic thought partner to executives — anticipating needs, connecting the dots across priorities, and helping them operate at their highest level

- Own executive communications, including drafting, editing, and managing correspondence that reflects each leader's voice with clarity and intention

- Prepare briefing materials, talking points, and context-setting documents to ensure executives are informed and ready for every meeting and moment

- Provide strategic administrative and project management support across a broad range of initiatives

- Lead complex calendar management and travel planning, balancing competing priorities with good judgment

- Prepare domestic and international travel arrangements and detailed itineraries

- Meticulously manage expenses on behalf of the executive team

- In collaboration with others, plan and execute team meetings, offsites, and other special functions

- Partner with internal stakeholders on cross-functional projects, initiatives, and events

- Serve as a trusted liaison internally and externally, representing our executives with grace, professionalism, and discretion at all times


**You are:**

- A strategic communicator who understands context and audience, and can translate complex ideas into clear, compelling language on behalf of others

- Flexible in terms of responsibilities and responsiveness, with a positive "can-do" spirit

- A quick learner with a "knack" for tech, able to figure out new systems and adapt on the go

- Independent, able to execute and prioritize with little direction and exercise sound judgment when making time-sensitive decisions

- A team player, able to thrive in a team setting with a willingness to help others

- A self-starter who knows when to trust your instincts and when to ask for help

- A problem solver who can find creative solutions efficiently and proactively

- Trustworthy, with impeccable discretion with sensitive company, customer, and personal information

- Extremely adaptable to the ever-changing needs of a fast-growing company


**You have:**

- 5+ years of experience providing dedicated, high-level support to one or more C-suite executives in a fast-paced startup environment, including complex calendar management and travel planning

- A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

- High proficiency in Google Apps, particularly Google Calendar and Google Docs

- A polished, professional demeanor and a track record of building trust with executives and VIP stakeholders

- The ability to juggle competing priorities with composure and good judgment in a dynamic, ever-changing environment


**Our benefits:**

- Generous paid time off

- 401k matching

- Comprehensive health plans for you and your family

- Supplemental mental health benefits

- Monthly wellness reimbursement

- Dog friendly offices

- Employee Discount Program!


**Pay range:**

$120,000 - $145,000 annually

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work. This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

##### Payroll Administrator

The Payroll Administrator will play a key role within the Finance team, overseeing all payroll-related functions and ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local payroll regulations. This position will also involve general accounting tasks and will collaborate closely with employees across the organization, with a particular focus on working with the Accounting, Finance, and People departments.

What you’ll do:

- Effectively prioritize to ensure compliance and accurate record keeping and ensure payroll is processed in compliance with multi-state wage and hour laws.
- Review and verify time sheets.
- Prepare and process payroll for approximately 65 employees.
- Prepare payroll and payroll related general ledger journal entries, understanding payroll related assets, liabilities, and expenses.
- Process miscellaneous off-cycle checks including final paychecks, severance, etc.
- Resolve internal and external employee inquiries in adherence to department service level agreements.
- Prepare and reconcile 401k contributions, deductions, and employer match submissions, understanding legal responsibilities of accurate and timely processing.
- Prepare worker compensation reports, reconciling payroll tax reports with an understanding of classification codes.
- Prepare and process benefit funding.
- Reconcile all benefits monthly and between the connecting benefits administrator to ensure all benefit deductions are accurate.
- General accounting support including various other projects and tasks such as reconciliations and year-end entries as directed by the Director of Accounting.
- Assist with audits, the 990, and 401k audit.
- Maintain compliance with payroll laws, regulations, labor union standards and other regulatory requirements.

Who you are:

- 2+ years full-cycle payroll experience, with strong experience using a payroll processing software (Rippling is a plus)
- Understanding of payroll-related deductions (e.g., benefits, 401k contributions, etc.)
- Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment
- Team oriented and able to work with employees at all levels
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills, including VLookup and Pivot tables
- Able to demonstrate complete discretion and confidentiality

Salary: $76,500
