SOLANA FOUNDATION

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5680736526932379265?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8342145920956585033&crId=US_0US_0)

About Alchemy
Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

About The Role
We’re looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist to join our Finance team and take ownership of daily AP activities, including accurate invoice coding, timely payments, vendor support, and reconciliations.

Reporting to our Procurement Manager, you’ll partner with Accounting and teams across Alchemy to keep our procure-to-pay process running smoothly across Zip, NetSuite, and Ramp. You’ll help strengthen existing processes, troubleshoot issues independently, and identify opportunities to improve how we work. This role requires attention to detail, dependability, and proactive communication.

What You’ll Do
Daily AP Operations

Manage the AP inbox, promptly process incoming invoices and requests, and serve as a primary point of contact for vendors and internal teams.

Review, enter, classify, and code vendor invoices in Zip and NetSuite, ensuring complete documentation, appropriate approvals, and purchase order matching where applicable.

Prepare payment batches for review and approval, monitor payment deadlines, and follow up on outstanding approvals or missing information.

Support vendor onboarding and maintain accurate vendor records, including tax forms, addresses, payment terms, and verified banking information.

Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, duplicate charges, missing credits, and payment issues; elevate exceptions when needed.

Review employee expenses and corporate card transactions in Ramp for accurate coding, receipts, approvals, and policy compliance.

Close Support & Special Projects

Reconcile AP activity and balances with the general ledger, investigate differences, and ensure invoices, credits, and payments are properly recorded.

Support month-end close by identifying unrecorded invoices and potential accruals and preparing supporting schedules for Accounting.

Maintain vendor tax documentation, including W-9s, and support annual 1099 preparation.

Follow established approval and payment controls, including verification procedures for vendor banking changes.

Maintain organized records and provide AP documentation for internal reviews and external audits.

Support system updates, workflow improvements, and other projects affecting procurement, expenses, accounts payable, and FP&A.

What We’re Looking For

2-4 years of experience in accounts payable or a related accounting operations role, with hands‑on responsibility for invoice processing and vendor support.

Curiosity about how processes work and initiative to make them better.

A solid understanding of invoice coding, purchase orders, payment terms, reconciliations, and basic accrual accounting.

Experience with accounting or ERP systems and the ability to learn new P2P, payment, and AI tools.

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling data across reports.

Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a habit of checking your work.

The ability to manage recurring deadlines, prioritize competing requests, and follow through independently.

Clear, practical communication and a collaborative approach to working with vendors and colleagues.

Nice to Haves

Experience with NetSuite, Zip, or Ramp.

Experience at a growing technology company or Big 4 accounting firm.

Experience improving AP workflows or using automation to reduce repetitive work.

Experience with crypto, digital assets, blockchain, or web3 is a plus, but not required.

William Vaughn TA

A leading professional services firm based in San Francisco is seeking a detail-oriented Billing Coordinator to join its finance team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate, timely billing and maintaining strong relationships with internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, understands the importance of precision, and can manage high-volume billing with confidence.

**Billing Coordinator Responsibilities**

• Manage full-cycle billing processes including prebill preparation, edits, and final invoice distribution

• Partner closely with attorneys, consultants, or project managers to review billing details and ensure accuracy

• Maintain billing schedules and ensure timely submission of invoices in accordance with client guidelines

• Process electronic billing through various e-billing platforms and client portals

• Monitor and resolve billing rejections, discrepancies, and submission issues

• Assist with accounts receivable follow-up, collections support, and aging analysis

• Prepare and maintain billing reports, WIP reports, and other financial tracking documents

• Ensure compliance with client-specific billing requirements and internal policies

• Support month-end close by providing billing data and reconciliation support

• Identify opportunities to streamline billing processes and improve efficiency

**Billing Coordinator Qualifications**

• 3-5+ years of billing experience, preferably within a professional services, legal, or consulting environment

• Strong understanding of full-cycle billing and client billing guidelines

• Experience with e-billing platforms such as Aderant, Elite, or similar systems

• Proficiency in Excel and financial systems

• High attention to detail with strong organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally

• Experience supporting high-volume billing environments preferred

# Project Coordinator

$85k - $96k

HGA

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2665304114367592505?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7776049560136886028&crId=US_0US_0)

**Overview:**
Project Coordinator

Location: San Francisco, CA

HGA is seeking a dynamic and driven Project Coordinator to join our San Francisco, CA Interior Design team. We’re looking for someone with exceptional communication, presentation, time‑management, and interpersonal skills—someone who thrives in a collaborative setting and is passionate about elevating design.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Interior Designers, Project Architects, and Project Managers to help shape innovative, technically sound design solutions. You’ll contribute to the development of detailed project documentation while upholding our firm’s commitment to design excellence and outstanding client service.

**What You’ll Do:**

Partner on the development of construction documents and ensure design intent is accurately carried through.

Translate complex project goals into creative and functional design solutions.

Collaborate across disciplines to coordinate architectural and engineering systems.

Participate in client meetings and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.

Partner to meet critical project milestones and deadlines maintaining a high level of attention to detail and quality.

**In this role you will:**

Develop a thorough understanding of projects’ design philosophy and provide major input in developing a design and building performance strategy, effectively conveying this to assigned team members when appropriate.

Provide technical design input and support for the development of the entire design concept.

Coordinate the project’s technical design effort, subsequent detailed design development, project coordination and quality control efforts during all phases of project work, in close collaboration with an Interior Designer, Project Architect, Senior Designer and Project Manager.

Seek creative and innovative solutions to assigned tasks and develop appropriate research and documents to support these solutions.

Actively collaborate with and coordinate work of consultants and knowledge resources to ensure the project deliverables are coordinated, integrated and support the design concept and performance goals of the project.

Contribute to the preparation of design documents and leads the detailed development of construction documents during all project phases, delivering complete, accurate and coordinated project documentation.

Advance the production of schematic, design development and construction document drawings and specifications in compliance with project scope, schedule, cost and design intent.

Review and coordinate project documents with relevant Building Codes, City Planning/Zoning ordinances and similar requirements for Authorities Having Jurisdiction.

Maintain awareness of evolving building technology and systems.

Review shop drawings, material samples and Construction Documents for conformance with design.

Perform construction administration duties (e.g., RFI’s, RFP’s, change orders, etc.).

Maintain contact with clients, consultants and contractors during all project phases, participating in marketing, client and owner presentations as required.

**What you will need to have:**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited Interior Design/Interior Architecture program or related field

5 to 7 years of experience working on small- to large-scale project types

Experience with TI and core and shell

Strong graphic skills

Revit knowledge and experience required

Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp and other industry accepted software as well as expertise with project management software and Microsoft Office Suite products is needed

Ability to travel to job sites

**Salary Information:**

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short- and long-term disability programs. Salary Range: $85,000 - $96,000 depending on qualifications and experience .

**Additional Information:**

HGA is a place where you can do your best work. We believe that enduring, impactful design results from deep insight into the people and passions that animate each unique environment. We value empathy, are fueled by curiosity, and embrace the hard work that leads to innovation. Equally important is our commitment to creating a culture of inclusivity and diversity where we encourage your originality, respect the need for flexibility and work-life balance, and empower your desired career growth. HGA is a national award-winning interdisciplinary design firm rooted in architecture and engineering.

Learn more about us here .

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

##### Finance and Operations Administrative Coordinator

MISSSEY prevents sexual exploitation of girls and gender-expansive youth, supports those experiencing it to exit, and partners with survivors to heal, rebuild, and live free from harmful relationships. As an organization, we value healing, youth voice, integrity, and relationships.

Our service model is focused on healing through trauma-informed, survivor-centered, and youth-focused approaches. We recognize the crucial voices of survivors in facilitating healing in victims of commercial sexual exploitation and the value of young people empowering other young people. Our work with youth is a partnership, helping them transition from victim to survivor to leader, encouraging their long-term stability and success in whatever path they choose. MISSSEY believes that with the right opportunities and support, youth can overcome the circumstances of their exploitation and thrive.

##### Position Summary

The Finance and Operations Administrative Coordinator plays an important role in ensuring accurate financial operations and effective administrative systems. Under the supervision of the Finance and Operations Director this role is primarily responsible for bookkeeping, financial processing, and operational coordination, while providing limited administrative support across the organization. The Finance and Operations Administrative Coordinator works in compliance with grants, contracts, and agency operational policies and procedures.

##### The Ideal Candidate For This Position Would:

- Have a minimum of 3 years' experience providing bookkeeping and administrative support
- Be professional, organized, and able to multitask and shift priorities as needed
- Be a continual learner deeply invested in women, girls, and gender-expansive youth
- Have the ability to develop good rapport with staff, partners, and community members
- Have the ability to co-create a strong, reflective, highly productive, and caring culture

##### Duties And Responsibilities:

##### Bookkeeping & Financial Operations (55%)

- Process accounts payable documentation and prepare payment requests for approval by the Finance & Operations Director in accordance with organizational internal controls.
- Administer the PEX card program, including card issuance, receipt collection, transaction monitoring, and reconciliation.
- Prepare monthly reconciliations for review and approval by the Finance & Administration Director.
- Data management in SAGE Intacct
- Prepare deposit logs and coordinate bank deposits
- Support month-end and year-end closing activities by providing required documentation to the Finance & Administration Director and external accounting consultants.
- Assist with grant billing and reimbursement requests by compiling supporting documentation and ensuring proper grant coding.
- Assist with annual audits, financial reviews, and funder monitoring visits by preparing financial records and supporting documentation.
- Monitor budget line expenditures and accounts and identify discrepancies or unusual transactions for management review
- Track vendor pricing and financial documentation
- Coordinate with MISSSEY's external accounting firm, Armanino, to provide requested documentation, respond to information requests, and participate in recurring financial coordination meetings.
- Create check requests for incoming bills and invoices and submit to Finance & Administration Director with coversheet weekly
- Ensure all reimbursement forms have appropriate documentation and receipts attached

##### Administrative & Operational Support (30%)

- Provide administrative and operational support to strengthen organizational efficiency and effective office operations.
- Maintain complete, accurate, and well-organized financial, operational, and compliance records.
- Administer electronic and physical document management systems, ensuring records are current, secure, and easily accessible.
- Serve as the primary administrative liaison with vendors, service providers, landlords, and IT partners for contracts, billing, payments, and routine operational matters.
- Coordinate the vendor onboarding process and maintain complete vendor files, including W-9s, contracts, insurance certificates, and payment documentation.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows and document standardized operating procedures that support organizational consistency and accountability.

##### Operational & Financial Training Support (5%)

- Train staff on operational and financial procedures, including:
 - PEX card usage and monthly reconciliation
 - Expense documentation and reimbursement requirements
- Provide ongoing guidance related to financial processes

##### Management Team Support (5%)

- Provide administrative support to the Finance and Operations team
- Support the Finance and Operations team with reporting and coordination

##### Other (5%)

- Handle sensitive information in a confidential manner
- Participate in supervision, staff meetings, and trainings
- Collaborate with the MISSSEY team on organization-wide initiatives
- Other duties as assigned

##### Qualifications:

- Minimum of three (3) years of experience providing bookkeeping, finance, and administrative support in a nonprofit organization.
- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and strong systems management skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and follow through on assignments with accuracy and consistency.
- Proven ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and proactively identify and resolve routine administrative and operational issues.
- Demonstrated ability to receive direction, incorporate feedback, and work collaboratively within established organizational policies, procedures, and supervisory guidance.
- Strong discretion and ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial, personnel, and organizational information.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and Google Workspace.
- Experience using financial management systems; experience with SAGE Intacct preferred.
- Preferred: Experience using Bill.com and PEX (pex.com) for accounts payable and expense management.
- Experience working in organizations serving African American cisgender, transgender, and non-binary women and girls.
- Commitment to supporting young people through healing-centered, survivor-informed, and trauma-informed practices.

##### Physical Demands:

- Occasional lifting of up to 50 lbs
- Daily computer use, including extended typing
- Ability to communicate verbally in person and by phone
- Ability to stand for at least 20 minutes at a time

##### Work Environment:

- In person
- Shared office space
- Occasional outdoor activities

##### Required Licenses and Certificates:

- Current driver's license, reliable transportation, and proof of insurance
- Criminal background check including fingerprint clearance
- TB clearance

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background screening in compliance with applicable California law.

##### Benefits:

- 100% employer-covered Medical, Dental & Vision
- Long-Term Disability & Life Insurance
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
- SIMPLE IRA with employer match
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Vacation available after 90-day period
- Paid sick time compliant with CA law
- Family and pet bereavement leave

##### Equal Opportunity Employer

MISSSEY is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage applications from people with marginalized identities — including but not limited to Black, Indigenous, and people of color; women; LGBTQ+ individuals; system-impacted people; and survivors of exploitation.

**Non-Discrimination Policy:** MISSSEY DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE IN ANY PROGRAM, ACTIVITY, OR IN EMPLOYMENT ON THE BASIS OF AGE, CREED, SEX, RACE, ETHNIC BACKGROUND, MARITAL OR VETERAN STATUS, NATIONAL ORIGIN, DISABILITY, SEXUAL ORIENTATION, OR RELIGION, SURVIVORS AND WOMEN OF COLOR (TRANS-INCLUSIVE) ARE ENCOURAGED TO APPLY

##### Field Operations Manager

As Field Operations Manager, you will own the physical side of how AIO reaches customers — from the moment hardware arrives at our warehouse through to installation, training, and ongoing in-person support at customer locations. This is a hands-on, Bay Area-based role with national shipping responsibility and direct customer contact.

You will lead a small field team, manage our hardware inventory end-to-end, and be the person customers and internal teams rely on when something physical needs to get done right.

What will your responsibilities be?

Customer Deployment, Installation & Training

- Lead the prep and configuration of hardware for all new customer deployments — from inventory to customer-ready
- Own Bay Area installations end-to-end: coordinate scheduling, lead or supervise on-site installs, and ensure every go-live meets AIO's standards
- Deliver hands-on customer training at installation, ensuring restaurant staff are confident using the system from day one
- Own installation SLAs — track team efficiency, identify bottlenecks, and hold the process to a consistent, high bar
- Coordinate outbound hardware shipments to customers outside the Bay Area, ensuring accurate packing, labelling, and timely dispatch

On-Ground Customer Support

- Manage the team delivering in-person technical support to Bay Area customers who are hard down, at churn risk, or require hands-on resolution
- Build and maintain support playbooks that enable the team to resolve common issues quickly and consistently
- Be willing to be in the field personally when the situation demands it — this is a working manager role

Hardware Inventory Ownership

- Own all physical inventory: receiving, organising, and maintaining accurate stock at the warehouse
- Lead weekly cycle counts and monthly physical inventory audits; resolve discrepancies promptly
- Ensure all hardware movement — inbound and outbound — is logged correctly so system records stay accurate
- Maintain storage protocols and ensure devices are properly staged, labelled, and ready for deployment

Team Leadership

- Directly manage the local field team — setting clear expectations, running structured check-ins, and developing each person's capabilities
- Build a culture of accountability where SLAs, accuracy, and customer outcomes are non-negotiable
- Coordinate with Pakistan-based operations colleagues on system records and workflow handoffs
- Monitor team capacity on an ongoing basis — tracking workload against pipeline, flagging when headcount is stretched, and partnering with the COO to get ahead of hiring needs before they become gaps

What are we looking for and what does it require to be the right fit for this role?

- 5+ years in field operations, implementation, logistics, or a hands-on customer-facing operations role.
- Experience managing a small team in a fast-moving environment.
- Comfortable with hardware — unboxing, configuring, troubleshooting, and shipping technology equipment.
- Organized and detail-oriented when it comes to inventory — you notice when something is off and you fix it.
- Natural with customers: able to build trust quickly, communicate clearly, and represent AIO well in someone's place of business.
- Valid driver's license and reliable access to transport for Bay Area site visits.
- Restaurant industry, hospitality tech, or POS experience is a meaningful plus.

Why Join AIO?

Our mission is to revolutionize the US restaurant industry by providing a comprehensive and fully integrated solution that empowers restaurant owners to efficiently manage all aspects of their business. Our platform combines our patented AI technology with unparalleled customer support to help owners increase revenue, reduce costs, and improve their overall profit margins.

We believe that restaurants should be able to focus on delivering exceptional dining experiences to their customers, without the added stress of managing complex and disparate systems. That's why we offer an All-In-One super app platform for all their needs, from front-of-the-house operations like ordering, payment, marketing and rewards, to back-of-the-house management like inventory, staff, and financials.

We are laser focused on becoming a significant player in the $55 billion restaurant tech SaaS market. You will be a part of a world class, up-and-coming Silicon Valley funded startup.

# Community Marketing Manager

Remote Services Inc.

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3816875401891786312?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8295119153282751851&crId=US_0US_0)

About Iru

Iru is the AI-powered security & IT platform used by the world’s fastest-growing companies to secure their users, apps, and devices. Built for the AI era, Iru unifies identity & access, endpoint security & management, and compliance automation—collapsing the stack and giving IT & security time and control back.

Iru is backed by some of the smartest investors in tech—General Catalyst, Tiger Global, Felicis, Greycroft, and First Round Capital. In July 2024, Iru raised $100 million from General Catalyst, valuing the company at $850 million. Customers include Cursor, Vercel, Lovable, Replit, and Mercor, and Iru partners with industry leaders such as ServiceNow and AWS. Iru was named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startup Employers 2025 list for employee engagement and satisfaction.

The Opportunity
Iru is hiring a Community Marketing Manager to build and lead the communities that connect us to the people who do IT and security work every day. We're looking for someone who can think, build, and own community as a real driver of how people discover and trust Iru.

This is a community-first role, and it's built for someone who thinks like a founder of the spaces they run. You'll create real gathering places for IT and security practitioners: a private community where they share knowledge and connect with each other and with Iru, and an authentic presence in the public spaces where they already are, from Reddit to the social channels that matter to this audience.

It's also a deeply creative role. We want someone who generates original ideas and who understands brand well enough to make it come alive across very different channels without ever feeling copy-pasted. You'll create, publish, engage, and build: always in service of community and brand.

You're already deep in online communities. You understand how IT and security practitioners talk, what they care about, and what makes them tune out the moment something feels like marketing.

Must be able to work Tuesday through Thursday onsite in our Coral Gables office.

What You'll Do

Build and grow community

Launch and lead Iru's private community for IT and security practitioners: define the structure, seed the first conversations, recruit founding members, and establish the norms and culture that make it worth showing up to

Build a genuine, valued presence in the public communities where this audience lives: Reddit, LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, and beyond

Design programming that keeps people coming back: AMAs, discussions, member spotlights, resource sharing, and formats no one's tried yet

Own community health end to end — growth, engagement, retention, and the quality of participation — and use what you learn to make the community better

Brand and original thinking

Come up with the ideas: campaigns, moments, and creative concepts that earn attention because they're genuinely good, not because they're boosted

# Sales Marketing Coordinator

Promaxo

[Oakland, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Oakland%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7660476807765705362?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5907&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6781013081316429474&crId=US_0US_0)

Promaxo is building the first fully integrated, point-of-care MRI platform for prostate cancer care — combining in-office MRI imaging, AI-assisted lesion detection, and robotic guidance to bring detection, biopsy, and treatment into a single clinical workflow. Our MRI system holds FDA 510(k) clearance for MRI-guided prostate biopsy, and our team is continuing to develop the AI screening, robotic guidance, and targeted-treatment capabilities that will extend the platform. We're a small, fast-moving medical device company based in Oakland, California, and we're looking for talented, mission-driven people who want their work to matter in the clinic.

Position Summary
The Sales & Marketing Coordinator is the hands-on support hub for Promaxo’s commercial team. This role generates and qualifies leads, serves as a first point of contact for current customer issues, guides new customers through orientation, runs Promaxo’s trade-show presence, and keeps marketing collateral current and on-brand. Working closely with Sales, Clinical, Field Service, and Operations, the Coordinator helps ensure every prospect and customer has a responsive, well-organized experience with Promaxo.

Key Responsibilities

Research prospects, conduct outbound calls and emails, qualify leads, and schedule meetings for the sales team; follow up promptly on inbound and event leads

Serve as a first point of contact for current customer questions and issues, routing and tracking them with Clinical, Field Service, and Operations through resolution

Coordinate new customer orientation, including welcome materials, key contacts, and scheduling of installation and training

Plan and manage trade shows and conferences (e.g., AUA), including booth logistics, shipping, pre-show outreach, on-site support, and post-show lead follow-up

Create, update, and organize marketing collateral, including brochures, product sheets, presentations, and website and LinkedIn content

Maintain accurate CRM records and prepare quotes, proposals, and sales materials as requested

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, life sciences, or a related field

2+ years of experience in sales support, marketing coordination, customer service, or a related commercial role

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first, problem-solving approach

Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-moving startup environment

Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce or HubSpot), Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and Canva or similar

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in medical device, healthcare technology, or capital-equipment sales

Experience coordinating trade shows or industry events

Willingness to travel up to 20%, primarily for trade shows and customer events

What We Offer

The chance to work on a novel, FDA-cleared medical device platform from day one, with direct visibility into how your work affects patient care.

Direct mentorship from commercial, clinical, and executive leaders — you will not be a cog in a large bureaucracy.

A collaborative, interdisciplinary environment where sales, clinical, and operations teams work side by side.

Competitive salary, equity, and paid time off, plus 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents.

**Job Title: Administrative Coordinator**

**Location:** **Los Angeles, CA 90017**

**Duration:** **13 Weeks** **(** **Part-Time, weekends (Saturday and Sunday), with a possibility of some weekdays if employee is available.)**

**XXXX: XXXXXXXXXXX/hr**

**Shift: Day 2x8 Hours \|\| 8:00 - 16:30**

**\*\*\*Candidate will be required to complete orientation and training during the week until done. Must be available M-F until training is completed.**

**Position Summary:**

Provides clerical support for Case Management team, assisting team with problem solving and facilitating inpatient and post hospitalization care.

**Duties And Responsibilities:**

- Safeguards and preserves the confidentiality of patient's protected health information in accordance with State and Federal (HIPAA) regulatory requirements, hospital and departmental policies.
- Ensures a safe patient environment and adherence to safety practices per policy.
- With consideration to age, employee utilizes the approved process to resolve biophysical, psychological, educational and environmental needs of patient/significant other when administering care.
- Discharge Planning
- Actively participates in daily Case Management team meetings.
- Follows up with phone calls and necessary paperwork to ensure seamless referrals to outside agencies.
- Collects information to facilitate assessment of financial resources available for post-acute care.
- Make arrangements for procuring and delivering DME and medications for post discharge care.
- Arranges timely transportation for discharge according to plan.
- Performs all clerical functions, such as, faxing, copying and telephoning as necessary to expedite patient discharge.
- Ensures all discharge plans are followed through to resolution or requests assistance as needed.
- Financial Assessment
- Ensures insurance verification and obtains benefits to ensure adequate coverage to meet the need of the discharge plan.
- Refers patients to financial counselors for information and/or to implement financial assistance forms.
- Maintains knowledge of common reimbursement methods.
- Communicates reimbursement information to patients and families as directed.
- Works collaboratively with RN and SW Case Manager to issue continued stay documents and denial information.
- Initiates disability applications.
- Accesses computer system to obtain updated financial information and benefits.
- Completes MAC paperwork and assists with county transfers.
- Maintains awareness of payor / reimbursement practices and regulations that may impact patients' plan of care.
- Psychosocial Coordination
- Completes mandated legal reporting as appropriate.
- Reports all observations/information to the Case Management team.
- Screens all cases for advanced directives documentation.
- Assist patient's families with education or completing paperwork for healthcare decisions under the direction of the SW/RN Case Manager.
- Clinical Case Coordination
- Helps ensure appropriate test results are available in a timely manner for physician review.
- Assists with coordination of Case Management paperwork for admissions, transfers and discharges.
- Monitors patients for frequent admissions and alerts Case Managers.
- Assists with obtaining appropriate resources as directed.
- Team Support Functions
- Follows up on pre-certification activities
- Coordinates admission notifications to third party payors with Admitting department.
- Maintains awareness of current managed care contract requirements for UR.
- Communicates pertinent information received from payors to Case Managers.
- Facilitates timely transmissions of concurrent and retroactive utilization reviews with insurance companies in coordination with RN Case Manager.
- Assists with Medi-Cal review process, copying patient records and assists with TAR completion.
- Supports process for insurance denials and appeal processes.
- Collects and enters data on avoidable delays/days.

**Skills:**

- Basic computer knowledge
- Medical terminology
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Critical thinking skill

**Required Qualifications:**

- High School diploma or equivalent
- LA City Fire Card within 6 months of employment (PHGSH only)
- Previous experience in a medical setting

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree preferred

Our client is seeking an Administrative Coordinator to support their growing sales team. Responsibilities Include:

Sales Process Support: Assist the sales teams with administrative and operational tasks throughout the sales lifecycle, from initial outreach through proposal coordination.

CRM Maintenance: Keep CRM records current and accurate by logging leads, notes, communications, and deal stages to support pipeline visibility and reporting.

Scheduling & Coordination: Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and help coordinate next steps to ensure timely follow‑through across active opportunities.

Brand Consistency: Assist in maintaining a consistent, professional tone and presentation across all sales communications and materials.

Tools & Systems: Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar systems; familiarity with prospecting or lead‑generation tools is a plus.

Organization & Detail: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

# Office Administrator

$23 - $25 per hour

California Closets

[Inglewood, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Inglewood%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7543873235298471795?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6516&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1304327757974683546&crId=US_0US_0)

Company Description
Founded in 1978, California Closets has built a reputation as the leader and design authority in premium space management, delivering custom-designed organizational solutions and exceptional service. We believe home is more than just a place — it should be a source of creativity, comfort, and connection. From beautiful walk-in closets and entertainment centers to versatile pantries and home offices, we design custom storage solutions that add value to your life and home by making space for what belongs. Think of it as ‘practical magic.’

Job Description
The Office Administrator is primarily responsible for coordinating office administrative tasks, accounts payable / receivable, and payroll functions for the company-owned location. This position works closely with all operation's teams and is responsible for providing complete, accurate and timely services.

Job Highlights

We're located on 709 Hindry Ave \| Los Angeles, CA 90301

The schedule for this position is Monday-Friday 7am to 3:30pm with flexibility needed.

The pay for this position is between $23 - $25/hour based on experience.

What We Offer

Health insurance – Medical, Dental, and Vision

PTO days and paid holidays

401K retirement plan with company match

Transportation from company’s location to and from customer job sites will be provided

Company tools and PPE provided

Day shift hours

Grow your career with us – many promotional opportunities available

Working with luxury products and 100% custom builds

Generous company discounts

Referral bonuses

Some locations provide cell phone stipends

Essential Functions
Office & Operational Administration

Serve as an administrative support resource for the CCO leadership team and local operations.

Process incoming mail and distribute correspondence appropriately.

Maintain organized electronic and physical office records.

Other duties or special projects as required by General or Office Manager

Frequent one on one contact with customers, sales team, and all internal departments to oversee efficiency and client satisfaction throughout the organization

Financial & Business Process Support

Support month-end reporting activities (including closing of A/R and confirmation of posted transactions) and operational data validation.

Support job administration activities, including maintaining required documentation and ensuring data accuracy within company systems.

Enter all customer payments (deposits, progress payments, and balances) into SalesForce accounts and also into Kinetic

Process Greensky (customer financing) balance payments

Create daily bank deposit batches in Kinetic

Close out jobs in SalesForce, verifying revenue accuracy based on contracted amount and any change orders, and ensuring it meets required revenue recognition standards

Scan and upload signed, job certificate of completion into appropriate SalesForce account

Perform a week and month-end reconciliation of installed revenue in partnership with centralized shared services group.

Bill all closed out jobs in Kinetic

Responsible for all accounts receivable activity/entries, including delinquent accounts, along with accurate reporting and communication.

Process Design Consultant commission in SalesForce CXT, ensuring commission accuracy, once jobs are closed and paid in full.

Produce a bi-weekly commission report for GM approval.

Customer & Team Support

Foster positive working relationships with customers, sales teams, and internal departments.

Assist in resolving administrative issues impacting customer satisfaction.

Support insurance certificate (COI) requests and annual updates.

Promote a culture aligned with company values and service standards.

Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.

Support the implementation of new systems, tools, and standardized processes.

Maintain compliance with company policies, procedures, and documentation requirements.

Qualifications

1-2 years of experience of administrative experience in construction and/or in the home renovations/improvement industry.

Associate degree related to business administration / accounting from an accredited college or university preferred.

Experience and/or knowledge of payroll legislation and automated accounting systems.

Ability to work quickly and accurately 10-key and data entry.

Familiar with GL Coding.

Calendar management / regional scheduling experience preferred.

Additional Information
We are an equal opportunity employer. We E-Verify.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

# Master Scheduler

$160k - $190k

Apex Systems Inc

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-9220322821122085192?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3276124903689219994&crId=US_0US_0)

Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge. For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles. Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more. We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

About The Role
Apex is looking for a Master Scheduler to own the company's overall schedule. This role builds and maintains the integrated master schedule that ties together product design, development, and program execution, and keeps leadership and every department tracking to plan. You will work across engineering, supply chain, production, program management, and leadership to build accurate schedules, surface risks early, and show clearly where the company is on plan and where it is not. This is a senior, cross-company role. It fits someone who can hold the big picture across many programs while staying close enough to the work to build a credible, bottoms‑up schedule.

Responsibilities

Own the integrated master schedule by building and maintaining the company-wide schedule that connects product design, development, and program execution across all programs.

Work with engineering to build design and development schedules, including major milestones, dependencies, and gates.

Create and manage detailed program execution schedules that drive on-time delivery and good use of resources.

Monitor progress across the company and its departments against the master schedule and show clearly where teams are on plan and where they are falling behind.

Learn the engineering development and production processes used to build Apex products and break down schedule tasks to reflect that technical scope.

Work with engineering, supply chain, production, and program management to keep schedules aligned and realistic.

Establish and maintain consistent scheduling processes, cadence, and standards so updates stay timely and schedules stay trustworthy across the company.

Identify risks to the schedule, work with teams on mitigation and contingency plans, and flag critical path issues early.

Address competing priorities and resource conflicts across programs to keep work moving.

Communicate schedule changes to the right stakeholders and make sure adjustments carry through the organization.

Provide regular updates to leadership on schedule health, progress, and major issues, including a clear read on whether the company is tracking to plan.

Requirements

U.S. Person status, as this role requires access to export-controlled data.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related field.

7+ years in scheduling or program planning, preferably in manufacturing or aerospace.

Track record building and owning complex, integrated schedules with many interdependent tasks across multiple programs or teams.

Strong understanding of engineering development and production processes.

Proficiency in scheduling software such as Microsoft Project and Smartsheet.

Experience building critical path and milestone schedules.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including working directly with leadership.

Comfort in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities.

Preferred

Experience owning a company-level or integrated master schedule (IMS).

Experience delivering IMSs on a U.S. Government Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL).

Experience in satellite manufacturing or related industries (aerospace, defense, or high-tech).

Certification in project management or scheduling (PMP, CPIM, PMI-SP, or Six Sigma).

Experience scheduling both product development and production, not just one.

Why Join Apex?
Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.

What We Offer For Full-time Employees

Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

Comprehensive PTO package: Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

Your dream desk setup: All the tools you need to be your most productive self

World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference

Additional Information
Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.

ITAR Requirements
Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C.

1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Apex Technology, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

# Bilingual Office Assistant

$22 - $27 per hour

AppleOne Employment Services

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7911313351493254830?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3792519268917369532&crId=US_0US_0)

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly organized and professional Bilingual Office Assistant for a temp-to-hire opportunity in Los Angeles, CA. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being the central point of contact in a busy office environment while providing administrative support in both English and Spanish.

This is a strong opportunity for a reliable administrative professional who values teamwork, supportive leadership, and the potential for long-term career growth.

Key Responsibilities

Answer and direct phone calls, emails, and customer inquiries in a professional and timely manner.

Greet and assist visitors, clients, vendors, and staff while providing excellent customer service.

Prepare, maintain, and organize office documents, records, files, and reports.

Schedule meetings, coordinate appointments, and manage calendars as needed.

Translate and interpret communications between English and Spanish when required.

Assist with data entry, office supplies, vendor coordination, and general administrative projects.

Compensation and Benefits

Pay Rate: $22.00 to $27.00 per hour.

Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire.

Location: Los Angeles, CA.

Required Qualifications and Skills

Provide bilingual administrative support for daily office operations.

Manage phone calls, emails, scheduling, filing, data entry, and office documentation.

Serve as a professional point of contact for clients, visitors, vendors, and internal staff.

Support management with office projects, reporting, and general clerical tasks.

Fluency in English and Spanish is required.

1 to 2 years of administrative, office support, receptionist, or clerical experience.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.

Excellent organization, attention to detail, and time management skills.

Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and work independently in a fast-paced office environment.

Professional, dependable, and comfortable handling confidential or sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience translating or interpreting basic business communications.

Experience supporting calendars, meetings, vendors, office supplies, and management projects.

Prior experience in a client-facing administrative or receptionist role.

Strong data entry accuracy and comfort maintaining organized digital and physical records.

Equal Opportunity Employer / Disabled / Protected Veterans

# Administrative Assistant

ACME

[Pasadena, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Pasadena%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4305247565182063347?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6586&pageType=7&jobAge=1698&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5311858813639766746&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description Job Description Highly reputable Egg Donation and Surrogacy Agency based in Pasadena has an immediate opening for an Administrative Assistant. Our mission is to guide Intended Parents, egg donors, sperm donors, and surrogates through one of the most meaningful journeys in life: building families. We know firsthand how much courage it takes to hope again after every setback, and we never give up on the people who trust us with their dream of a family. That dedication is why we come to work each day. This is one of the most important roles at our agency. Our Admin Assistants are one of the first team members to connect with the egg donors, sperm donors, and surrogates who apply to our program. You will often be the welcoming voice on the other end of that first conversation, conducting initial interviews to understand each applicant and confirm they meet the qualifications to join our program. Once an applicant successfully completes this preliminary screening, you will hand them off to a Case Coordinator, who guides them through the next steps of their journey with us. This is a role where warmth and judgment matter in equal measure. Every applicant you speak with is a real person hoping to help build a family, and how you treat them sets the tone for their entire experience with our agency. Your first 90 days will be an introductory training period, during which we will teach you our policies and procedures from the ground up. Your role may require you to conduct an initial screening interview to get to know each applicant and confirm they meet our program's qualifications. You will guide applicants warmly through the earliest stage of their journey and answer their questions with care. You will handle related administrative tasks with accuracy and discretion, always protecting highly confidential information. This role is open to anyone passionate about our industry and our mission. No prior recruitment, sales, or industry experience is necessary — we will teach you everything you need to know. Relevant experience is a welcome plus, but it is never a requirement. Summary
Keystone Law Group is seeking a talented Administrative Assistant to enhance our dynamic and growing team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in administrative support within a legal environment and demonstrate key skills such as attention to detail, strong interpersonal communication, and the ability to work both independently and as a member of a team. This role is pivotal to the Operations Department, where you will collaborate closely with and report to the managers of the department as well as the Director of HR and Operations to achieve departmental and firm-wide objectives.

About Us
Based in West Los Angeles (with remote employees across the country), Keystone Law Group is a forward-thinking probate law firm with a focus on trust, estate, and conservatorship litigation, administration, and other probate disputes. The firm is a boutique practice with around 60 employees, all dedicated to delivering superior client service through a culture grounded in excellence, innovation, collaboration, and camaraderie. Continuous learning, open communication, strong relationships, and the thoughtful use of cutting‑edge technology support both client outcomes and the firm's internal team.

The Operations Department is the backbone of Keystone, ensuring seamless day‑to‑day functionality. We optimize operational processes, manage resources, and implement policies that align with the firm's strategic goals. Our commitment to excellence in service delivery and risk management upholds the firm's reputation for reliability and professionalism.

Location
Position is hybrid with 4 days per week in the office.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Answer, screen, and direct incoming calls

Update office forms and templates

Prepare and finalize minutes for various internal meetings, including team and support staff meetings

Own the client satisfaction survey workflow, including reporting and analytics

Liaise with building management to address facility‑related issues, including administration of building safety policies and trainings

Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding administrative duties, including updating firm documents, communication with third party vendors, and coordinating equipment setup

Provide administrative support to Operations managers and directors to ensure efficient office operations, including participation in physical item audits, client and vendor gifts, electronic filing and organization

Respond to and resolve administrative inquiries and questions, including booking of conference rooms and hotel offices

Perform analysis of inbound call data from Teams and outsourced phone vendor to assess service quality and cost effectiveness

Assist with inventory and upkeep of the firm's knowledge center

Assist with firm renewals for various vendors, insurances, State Bar, LACBA, etc.

Provide backup support to Receptionist and Mail & Facilities Clerk

Other responsibilities, administrative tasks, overflow work and projects, as assigned

Qualifications

Professional, pleasant, and welcoming demeanor

Strong interpersonal skills

Superior verbal and written communication skills

Must possess extreme attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Ability to work independently and as a member of team

Ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a fast-paced office environment

Familiarity with Windows, Microsoft Office applications (Word and Excel), Adobe Acrobat, etc., document management systems, and task/project management systems

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree strongly preferred

Professional services or law office administrative experience preferred

Experience handling high call volume strongly preferred

Salary Range & Benefits

Hourly rate is $25.00 to $33.00 (equivalent to $52,000 to $68,640 annually), depending on experience, plus discretionary bonus

Keystone offers competitive benefits, such as: employer-paid employee medical, dental, and vision with optional buy up; employer-paid life insurance; lifestyle spending account to support wellness; 401(k); paid time off and floating holidays; and more

Upon an offer of employment, Keystone Law Group completes a background check, reference check, and verification of employment. Where applicable, qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the California Fair Chance Act, and any other applicable federal, state, and/or local laws/ordinances.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Ascend Talent** **Solutions** **-** **Administrative** **Assistant** **Job Description**

**Our client is searching for an Administrative / Property Assistant for temp to hire opportunity.  This is an onsite position in the Miracle Mile neighborhood.**

**Job Description**– The Administrative Assistant will primarily focus on supporting the management team with periodic reporting responsibilities. With excellent customer service skills, the Administrative Assistant will also work resolving issues and executing on special requests. The successful Administrative Assistant will work with vendors and team members to ensure procedures are followed. Additional responsibilities for the Administrative Assistant include the following:

**Responsibilities Include:**

- Answering phones, greeting visitors, and providing administrative support to the management team.
- Preparing and updating files ensuring completeness and accuracy.
- Maintains calendar, triages incoming calls/correspondence and priority requests.
- Assisting and coordinating that all key assignments, deadlines, and projects are met.
- Utilizes strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and rapidly changing priorities.  Keeps management team informed of progress or delays.
- Schedules and coordinates meetings for the management team, scheduling and setting up conference rooms, coordinating audio/visual needs and handouts, making food arrangements and communicating with team members as required.
- Draft correspondence as directed. This drafting requires a command of the English language as well as working knowledge of business letter formatting and grammar.
- Orders and renews subscriptions and processes dues payments.
- Reconciles purchasing cards and expense reports.
- Coordinates and confirms conference reservation and related travel arrangement for management team.
- Preparing presentations for the department and responding to correspondence on the management team’s behalf.
- Preparing expense reports and ensuring appropriate approvals are timely and submitted properly.

**Position Requirements**

- 1-2 years of previous Administrative Assistant experience
- Highly proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
- Professional, reliable, flexible and have a positive, can-do attitude.
- Excellent attention to detail with strong customer service skills and ability to prioritize
- Ability to communicate well in both written and verbal communication forms.
- Proactive attitude and volunteers willingly to take on additional responsibilities and assist with other team members’ projects.

**Education**

- Bachelor’s degree preferred or similar work experience

Compensation: 60-65K range DOE

# Media Administrative Coordinator

The Dominguez Firm, LLP.

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5591593873511766994?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=258&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7220445813333892523&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

The Dominguez Firm is a well-established and nationally recognized personal injury law firm committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients. Our Marketing Department plays a critical role in driving client acquisition through high-impact advertising across TV, radio, and print media.

We are seeking a **highly organized and detail-oriented Marketing Operations Coordinator** to support our marketing team with campaign tracking, billing reconciliation, and administrative coordination. This is an excellent opportunity for a strong administrative professional who thrives in a structured, fast-paced environment and enjoys working with data, reporting, and process accuracy.

**Position Overview**

This role is responsible for **ensuring accuracy, organization, and execution of marketing campaigns and financial tracking processes** . The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working in **spreadsheets** , **tracking detail** s, **reconciling information** , and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.

You will work closely with the Media Manager and Marketing team to support advertising initiatives and ensure all campaign data, billing, and documentation are accurate and up to date.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Campaign Tracking & Reporting**

- Review and verify weekly activity logs to ensure accuracy of scheduled advertising placements
- Track and reconcile ordered vs. delivered advertising (e.g., ads scheduled vs. ads aired)
- Maintain organized reporting spreadsheets and update campaign performance data
- Compile and maintain documentation for active campaigns (including logs, reports, and records)

**Billing & Expense Reconciliation**

- Process and reconcile monthly vendor invoices against internal tracking reports
- Track marketing-related expenses, including credit card transactions
- Maintain accurate records of marketing spend and identify discrepancies
- Communicate with vendors and internal teams to resolve billing issues as needed

**Administrative & Operational Support**

- Maintain organized files, reports, and marketing documentation
- Coordinate communication with external vendors and internal stakeholders
- Support campaign execution by ensuring all materials and tracking tools are up to date
- Assist with special projects and cross-functional initiatives as needed

**Competitive & Market Tracking**

- Assist with compiling weekly reports on competitor advertising activity
- Track and organize market data and insights for internal use
- Monitor trends and maintain documentation of competitor activity

**Qualifications**

- Bilingual in English and Spanish (required)
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience)
- 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, operations, billing, or coordinator role
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data tracking, organization, and reporting)
- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with invoice processing, billing reconciliation, or expense tracking
- Experience supporting marketing, operations, or finance teams
- Familiarity with reporting tools or databases (training provided for industry-specific platforms such as Nielsen and MediaRadar)
- Experience in a law firm or professional services environment is a plus

**Who You Are**

- You enjoy working with spreadsheets, tracking data, and keeping things organized
- You have a strong attention to detail and take pride in accuracy
- You are comfortable reviewing information, identifying discrepancies, and following up
- You can manage multiple tasks and deadlines without losing focus
- You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your work

**Why Join The Dominguez Firm**

- Join a respected and growing law firm with a strong market presence
- Be part of a collaborative and fast-paced Marketing team
- Gain exposure to large-scale advertising campaigns
- Opportunity for growth and development within the organization

# Receptionist

$18.42 - $20 per hour

Disability Community Resource Center

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2923148232320445208?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2671025420530683458&crId=US_0US_0)

POSITION TITLE: Receptionist
CLASSIFICATION: Non-Exempt
REPORTS TO: Administrative Office Manager
SALARY RANGE: $18.42 - $20.00 per hour DOE

## JOB SUMMARY

The Receptionist is under the direction and supervision of the Administrative Office Manager and is responsible for basic office and receptionist duties.

## SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Answer phones; take messages as needed.

Greet people in the reception area.

Coordinate activities for reception area.

Implement procedures for receiving mail, taking of messages, and directing of visitors.

Perform light clerical duties, including typing, copying, data entry, and faxing.

Assist in coordinating and scheduling repair and maintenance of office equipment, as needed.

Maintain postage records.

Ensure facilities are tidy and well-stocked.

Participate on self-directed work teams and staff committees.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Administrative Office Manager.

## ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Demonstrate advanced knowledge of the Independent Living movement, the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, and other related laws and regulations governing programs offered by DCRC.

Demonstrate advanced knowledge and sensitivity engaging with diverse disability groups including but not limited to: Deaf/Hard of Hearing; Mental Health; Cognitive and Developmental Disabilities; Blind/Low-vision; Physical Disabilities; and Learning Disabilities.

Interact with co-workers regarding independent living issues and provide coverage when co-workers are absent.

Convey the independent living philosophy and principles of member control, equal access, and equal opportunity throughout delivery of services.

Demonstrate commitment to DCRC and to the vision, mission, and management philosophy of the agency.

Protect the health, safety and confidentiality of members (and coworkers) in all facets of the job.

Adhere to agency policies and procedures – particularly those dealing with confidentiality – in all aspects of agency operations.

Participate in developing and sustaining a healthy organizational culture based on safety, mutual regard, and open communication.

Maintain accurate and detailed records; documenting, in particular, service to members.

Advocate for the rights of consumers and the enforcement of the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Complete all other duties as assigned in a responsible, professional and timely manner.

## SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability desired. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Possess interpersonal skills needed to interact effectively and diplomatically with a variety of staff, volunteers and members of the

Basic supportive counseling and crisis intervention skills.

Ability to communicate effectively (oral/written).

Knowledge of basic computer applications and report writing.

Organizational skills, ability to work both independently with minimal supervision, and as a team member.

Valid California Driver’s License, proof of insurance, or the ability to effectively arrange personal transportation locally and regionally.

Life experience with a disability as well as knowledge of the Independent Living Movement philosophy preferred.

## WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work is performed primarily indoors, in the office.

Community outreach requires some degree of local and regional travel, and the occasional outdoor event.

Office environment includes moderate levels of noise and interruption.

Stress level is moderate: expected to think clearly in emergencies, complete work with deadlines, deal with interpersonal conflicts, and work with frequent interruptions.

## AAP/EEO STATEMENT:

The Disability Community Resource Center is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. People with disabilities, females, minorities and elderly persons are encouraged to apply for employment.

This job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other activities, duties and/or responsibilities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

ScaleJet

About the job Executive Assistant

Our client, Trivium Group, is looking for a dynamic and proactive Executive Assistant to provide crucial support to their CEO. Your role will be pivotal in maintaining the operational efficiency of our organization, allowing their leadership to stay focused on strategic priorities.

**About company:**

Trivium is a digital marketing agency specializing in scaling brands on Amazon. Built on a foundation of adding value to brands, Trivium excels at creating cutting edge strategies to dominate the market on Amazon, whether it is for enterprise brands, or brands just launching. Our goal is to become a guiding light for the industry through and impact 10,000 brands.

**Key Responsibilities:**

\- Admin Support: Take charge of various administrative tasks, from managing orders and insurance forms to handling emails and calendars.

\- Procurement: Be the go-to person for ordering supplies and handling requests efficiently.

\- Email Management: Skillfully respond to non-urgent emails and ensure relevant messages reach the right recipients.

\- Calendar Management: Keep things running smoothly by scheduling appointments and managing the CEO's calendar.

\- Travel Coordination: Show off your organizational prowess by booking seamless travel arrangements and providing needed information.

\- Event Assistance: Get involved in event planning and lend a hand with the financial aspects of it all.

\- Financial Tasks: Handle selected payments.

\- Team Communication: Be the glue that keeps our team connected by assisting with Slack communication and logins.

\- Reporting: Showcase your analytical skills by generating reports and managing data analysis tasks.

\- Employee Support: Extend a helping hand to employees on sick leave and assist in conducting surveys.

\- Personal Support: Efficiently handle any other tasks as needed to support the CEOs role and contribute to the success.

**Qualifications:**

\- Previous experience in an executive assistant role or a similar position is a Must Have.

\- Strong organizational and communication skills.

\- Proficiency in office software is a must, and your multitasking abilities will be put to good use.

\- Discretion and respect for confidentiality are qualities we highly value.

\- Ready and able to promptly address any urgent tasks that may arise. Know the nature of the tasks and their priorities.

\- Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities - because flexibility is key in our fast-paced environment.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

\- Competitive $70k annual salary

\- Semi flexible work hours

\- Partially remote work - you will need to come to the office (based in Culver city) once a week

\- 4 weeks paid vacation + sick time

If you're based in California and ready to start right away, this contractor opportunity is for you. The working hours are semi-flexible, allowing you to adjust to the CEO's schedule and various time zones. All you need is a quiet workspace and fast internet to excel in this role. Don't miss out on this exciting opportunity!

# Executive Assistant, Experienced

Blue Shield of CA

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-9136713258389669166?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2192360166165143009&crId=US_0US_0)

Your Role The Provider Network Management Team is responsible for the development, negotiation, implementation, and ongoing management of Blue Shield of California's provider contracting across California. The team oversees relationships and contractual arrangements with hospitals, health systems, medical groups, IPAs, and ACOs across Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medi-Cal, and other government-sponsored programs. The Executive Assistant, Experienced, will report to the VP, Provider Network Management. In this role you will serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters pertaining to the office of the executive and the leadership on the Provider Network Management Team. You will be the liaison to Network Strategy, Network Operations and Clinical Teams within Healthcare Quality & Affordability (HQA) Team; monitor and respond to emails, heavy scheduling and managing calendar meetings; organize and coordinate all travel and arrange special events and onsite/offsite events.
The Executive Assistant, Experienced must be creative, agile and nimble, and enjoy working in an entrepreneurial environment that is member-driven, results-driven, and service-oriented. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment and high level of discretion, with strong written and verbal communication, scrupulous administrative and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain balance among multiple competing priorities. The Executive Assistant, Experienced position requires the ability to work independently as well as within a team environment on projects from inception to completion and must be able to work under pressure to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.
Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow - personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.
This person will be required to live within 50 miles of the Woodland Hills office. Hybrid in-office expectation will be 2x per week, 8x per month.
Your Knowledge and Experience Requires a Bachelor's degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
Requires at least 3 years of prior relevant experience executive support
Requires 3 years of prior scheduling meetings and traveling for at least 1 senior level manager
Requires this person to live within 50 miles of the Woodland Hills office
Requires experience working at a health plan (managed care, government payer, or academic)
Requires ability to occasionally travel to offsite team events and/or meetings as needed
At least 3 years of experience supporting two or more leaders in a fast-paced professional environment desired
Requires expert proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including PowerPoint and electronic communications
Requires the ability to be both service-oriented and behind the scenes leader
Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously
Possess excellent organizational skills and ability to design, set-up and manage internal processes and protocols
Manage collaboratively and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
Possess a positive, can-do attitude and value continuous professional development; good judgement, attention to detail, keen sensitivity and responsiveness to executive's needs and requests
Hybrid This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.
Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.
